launches.title: 🧑‍⚕️ Andy AI - Faster clinical documentation for home health nurses
launches.tagline: Agencies see timely & accurate documentation and happier nurses.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re [Tiantian](https://linkedin.com/in/tiantianzha) and [Max](https://linkedin.com/in/akhterov), the founders of [Andy](https://with-andy.com).

**Andy completes clinical documentation for nurses doing home health visits**.

### **What is home health?**

Skilled nursing in the home is a booming business, on track to double to $250B in by 2031. Better outcomes, lower costs, and aligned with patient preferences: it’s no surprise large insurers are scooping up home health providers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78586&key=user_uploads/932678/56616808-3fe2-4b7d-8bdb-b670e0ed70e2)

### **The problem: too much charting**

On the ground, however, we’re seeing widespread burnout among nurses. The worst part of the job is documentation, which can take 90 minutes for a single patient and costs agencies $8B per year. Agencies that employ these nurses struggle to submit _high-quality_ documentation in a _timely_ manner, which is hurting their top line.

### **The solution: an AI scribe**

Andy is an AI-powered ambient scribe designed specifically for home health nurses. Nurses record their visits using their Andy app and receive a chart completed by Andy straight into their EHR. With Andy, the 90-minute documentation process is now a 15-minute review.

### **Meet Team Andy**

We’re a healthcare & AI team focused on pressing public health challenges. America’s rapidly aging population needs home health. We’re building tools to restore joy & connection to the profession.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78586&key=user_uploads/932678/325091cd-9334-41c7-a3c0-551987559a77)

* [**Tiantian Zha**](https://linkedin.com/in/tiantianzha) previously led an AI and robotics project at Google Life Sciences to eliminate mosquito-borne diseases, a public health challenge affecting 400M people each year.
* [**Max Akhterov**](https://linkedin.com/in/akhterov) previously built health AI algorithms for the Apple Watch, including the passive detection of atrial fibrillation which is running on 50M devices.

### **How you can help**

Do you know any home health operators? Please share [Andy](https://with-andy.com) to help them get accurate documentation done on time!

launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re [Anton](https://www.linkedin.com/in/antonotaner/) and [Tommy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tommyhe6/) and we’re building [Clarum](https://clarum.ai/?utm_source=yc&utm_campaign=launch).

**tldr;** Clarum helps private equity firms close more deals by conducting quicker due diligence with AI. For example, firms can import files from their data room to get answers to hundreds of questions in minutes. [Book a demo](https://clarum.ai/demo?utm_source=yc&utm_campaign=launch) with us!

### **Problem**

During deal flow, due diligence is a significant challenge for investors due to the need to **quickly process large volumes of disorganized data within tight deadlines**. The mental and emotional toll is significant, especially when dealing with high-stakes transactions worth millions, where mistakes can cost jobs. Private equity firms risk losing deals or being outbid if they don't conduct due diligence efficiently enough. Finding information and answering questions should be quick, easy, and reliable.

### **Clarum is here**

Clarum provides AI-powered due diligence solutions that enable fast, transparent, and reliable insights from your entire data repository, for more data-driven processes.

Using Clarum takes minutes to set up.

1. Import your data from your VDR, shared drive, or local computer.
2. Upload an existing due diligence questionnaire.
3. Watch Clarum answer 100s of questions with full transparency in minutes.

Here’s what Clarum can do:

**Reliable and traceable answers -** Answer questions using your entire knowledge base, where every number or sentence is linked back to its source document for full traceability.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79333&key=user_uploads/1524877/df101c73-a679-4a78-8f56-395da9a45d46)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79333&key=user_uploads/1524877/75217982-44fa-4faf-938c-627d903b594b)

All of this leads to a quicker time-to-insight, giving PE firms using Clarum a competitive advantage.

### **Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79333&key=user_uploads/1524877/9d56a75e-8694-4e63-8cca-0a3168762c63)

Anton Otaner and Tommy He met via a mutual friend at McGill University. They knew that they would be a great team after they won first place in their university’s hackathon and after many late nights working together.

Before that, he worked on the private intersection of knowledge graphs at Optable, an ad-tech startup.

Their background is rooted in a tech-first approach, tightly coupled with finance. By constantly keeping up to date and working with the latest technologies, they are convinced that due diligence could be accelerated with AI.

### **Our ask**

We are confident that we can accelerate your due diligence reliably using AI. If you know anyone working in private equity or wealth management who could benefit from Clarum, please [send them our way](https://mailto:anton@clarum.ai/).

launches.title: camelAI — The First Deep Research Agent for Your Structured Data
launches.tagline: Ask questions, get insights from your data.
launches.body:
Hi YC! We're [Illiana](https://www.linkedin.com/in/illiana-reed/), [Miguel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/miguel-salinas-b2781426/), and [Isabella](https://www.linkedin.com/in/isabellareed/), the team behind camelAI.

# What We're Building

camelAI is the last BI tool you'll ever need. What AI has done for coding, camelAI is doing for analytics. We connect an LLM directly to your database, turning natural language questions into in depth reports complete with beautiful visualizations in seconds. No modeling, no drag-and-drop limitations, no tickets to the data team.

<https://youtu.be/bBqdaNN-NpM>

# The Problem: Text-to-SQL Has Failed

Let's be honest: Text-to-SQL has been around for years. It's been done to death and it still leaves users frustrated. Instead of giving clear answers, Text-to-SQL makes users fight for insights:

* Setup takes forever
* Queries only work well for narrow, predictable questions
* Results come as raw data tables, not analysis
* Business users struggle to get actionable insights

Business users don't want raw tables of data—they need clear insights. But text-to-SQL forces them to piece together answers manually, leaving them frustrated and no closer to a decision.

The real problem: Getting valuable insights out of your own data is still too hard and too time consuming.

For executives, founders, and product managers, this means:

* Waiting days for simple data requests
* Making decisions without complete information
* Spending hours building and maintaining dashboards
* Wasting precious engineering time for a "quick data pull"

For technical teams, it means:

* Constant context-switching to answer basic data questions
* Building one-off dashboards that are rarely used
* Explaining the same metrics repeatedly

## Our Solution: camelAI

Ask camelAI anything - from basic KPIs to complex business metrics your team hasn't even thought to track:

**Deep Research Agent:** Watch as our Agent writes SQL queries in real time, explores your data, and generates interactive visualizations that deliver immediate insights. Complete transparency at every step.

**Learns Your Company:** camelAI learns your company's language through use. It remembers past queries and improves through your feedback, creating consistent company-specific analysis.

**Instant Visualizations:** camelAI doesn't just dump query results; it automatically creates interactive Plotly visualizations with written analysis of what the data actually means.

**One-Click Dashboards:** Any visualization can be saved to a dashboard that refreshes automatically. Create comprehensive dashboards in minutes, not hours.

**Enterprise-Ready:** We support on-prem and VPC deployments across multiple databases.

# The New Reality

Without camelAI:

1. Adding tickets to sprints for basic data questions
2. Waiting days for simple insights
3. Engineers constantly pulled away from building products

With camelAI:

1. Business teams get answers immediately
2. Engineers focus on building products
3. Founders make better decisions faster

## Who Needs This Yesterday

* **Founders** who can't afford to wait for data
* **Product Teams** tracking metrics without a dedicated analyst
* **CTOs** tired of being the bottleneck for data requests
* **Junior Analysts** who want to focus on insights, not queries

# Setup Takes 60 Seconds

1. Connect your data source — pick from 10+ connections or upload a CSV
2. Ask your first question
3. Start making better decisions

# 🐪 How We Got Here

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76776&key=user_uploads/1925221/b319f130-c38f-4080-8e5c-8edf8d77e91d)

We've been shipping products together for three years. We're not data analysts, and that was the problem.

Our organized data was right there, but we couldn't get to it without SQL expertise or wrestling with clunky BI tools that never quite answered our actual questions. So we built the tool we needed.

Our insight was simple: stop writing SQL queries by hand. Let AI do what it's good at. Let humans ask natural questions and get answers they can use right away.

## Try camelAI Today

Our free tier gives you 10 messages per week: <https://camelai.com/>

Questions? We read every email: [illiana@camelai.com](mailto:illiana@camelai.com)

Looking for: Teams tired of SQL bottlenecks who want to transform how they use data.

Creatives have become the biggest lever on ad platforms. Yet, there is no clear way to figure out WHY something works. You end up guessing and replicating the best performing ad, only to see it fail - high CAC & wasted budget. 

Our AI Creative Strategist:

1. **Finds patterns that you miss**: by analysing 1000s of creatives (down to the last pixel) and their performance data
2. **Builds a winning playbook**: which hooks, messaging, format, music, CTAs, storylines, influencers etc. really work for you

Picture this. 

You finally find a winning creative and you replicate it - make 5 variations. But almost all of them fail - high CAC and wasted $ on production.

Why? _Because you didn’t really know WHAT made the ad work!_

Creatives have 100s of moving parts and it’s impossible to find patterns manually. So most marketers make an educated guess, which often leads to unpredictability & low hit rate.

**Guess what works —> Low hit rate —> Poor CAC + wasted $ on prod**

# **Launch winning ads with our AI Creative Strategist**

The best marketing teams approach creative testing like an assembly line. We make this process simpler:

1. **Find patterns that you miss**: 

   We go into the depths of every creative - be it an image or a video and break it down into 100s of elements. This is combined with the performance data from your ad account to find what works
2. **Build a winning playbook**: 

   Every brand needs a playbook, a checklist that becomes the guiding principle of creative testing. We help you create this in terms of which hooks, messaging, format, music, CTAs, storylines, influencers etc. really work for you
3. **Get recommendations on what to launch next:** 

   Based on the patterns found + your brand’s playbook, we come up with a detailed creative brief every week that helps the creative team ship out ads faster than ever

* Good enough historical data i.e. more than 6 months running ads

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83700&key=user_uploads/1019731/e39b0b4e-22ea-4e62-85a4-d5421cafb7d5)

# **Our Story**

Hey! I’m [Brooke](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bnhop/), the founder of [Coval](https://www.coval.dev/). 👋

Before starting Coval, I led the evaluation job infrastructure team at [Waymo](https://waymo.com/). I coded the first versions of our dataset storage and other foundational simulation systems, and my team built all of the dev tools for launching and running evals.

Through my conversations with hundreds of engineering teams at startups and enterprises, I've seen that AI agents—models that operate independently and handle complex tasks—are facing similar challenges to those in self-driving. 

In the early days, autonomous vehicle companies relied heavily on manual evaluation, testing the self-driving cars on racetracks and city streets (remember when autonomous cars still had safety drivers?). However, as startups scaled, a significant shift happened: we moved towards simulating every code change in a “virtual” environment, using the vast amounts of data we collected. The new approach dramatically improved vehicle behavior, leading to hundreds of autonomous cars zipping around the San Francisco streets today!

This story mirrors what's happening today with AI agents across various industries. Teams are coming up with promising prototypes but often hit a wall when it comes to their reliability. 

As we build for the future, where AI agents execute much of our work, ranging from sending emails to prescribing medication, the risks posed by untested systems could severely throttle the progress.

At Waymo, I developed tools that tested each code modification made by engineers, ensuring that every change improved the Waymo Driver's performance. I believe this methodical approach was key in helping our team address edge cases and maintain peak performance, and it ultimately cemented Waymo's status as a leader in the autonomous vehicle space.

Now, at Coval, we’re taking these proven strategies and adapting them in a completely new way to speed up the development of AI agents. Our goal is to help engineers build agent experiences that genuinely work for users in the real world.

Automated simulation and evaluation are critical to trusting agents with impactful tasks across industries.

# **Working With Us**

Building agents or know someone? Let’s talk! [Grab time with me here](https://bit.ly/coval-demo) for a quick intro, or message me at [brooke@coval.dev](mailto:brooke@coval.dev).

**🙈 TL:DR:** Companies selling physical products spend a fortune on accounting and are still left with incorrect financials because of inventory related complications. We fix that.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82712&key=user_uploads/505183/a2949d25-3407-403c-88d4-f6f9beff9ce7)

🥵 **PROBLEM**: Companies selling physical products struggle with accounting and inventory operations. Current bookkeeping methods rely heavily on manual input and are often disconnected from accurate inventory data. This leads to mistakes in important financial figures like cost of goods sold (COGS), inventory value, margins, and cash flow. As a result, businesses spend a lot of time and money only to gain an inaccurate picture of their financial health. These inaccuracies lead to poor budgeting decisions, loan rejections, failed fundraising, non-compliance, and frequent cash flow crises.

😍 **OUR SOLUTION:** A powerful AI accounting agent built specifically for companies selling physical products.

Our platform automates bookkeeping and completes a variety of crucial product operations tasks such as calculating COGS, optimizing POs, and conducting contribution margin analysis with only a few clicks.

All financial and inventory data is connected and written back to QBO or your ERP, eliminating financial statement errors, saving dozens of hours per month, and thousands on accounting costs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82712&key=user_uploads/505183/56544b6d-0310-4c0e-a398-09bdb3945f94)

Doing the financials required an expensive team and the books were always inexplicably wrong. As as a result, the company was underwritten for debt and equity incorrectly, wasn’t able to make proper budgeting decisions, couldn’t forecast inventory needs, couldn’t optimize channel mix, and was blindsided by cash shortfalls.

## The problem

Property management and hospitality teams still run operations through a tangled stack: inboxes, PMS tools, spreadsheets, phone calls, manual coordination, and a dozen point solutions that don't talk to each other.

The "AI" in this space today is mostly chatbots that answer guest messages. That's a feature, not a workforce.

## What we built

ProhostAI's AI employees do real operational work — alongside the humans running the business. They can:

* **Answer guests** across Airbnb, Vrbo, [Booking.com](http://Booking.com), SMS, WhatsApp, email — omnichannel and context-aware
* **Take and place phone calls**
* **Create and assign tasks** to teammates
* **Coordinate cleaners** and schedule turnovers
* **Power guidebooks** for properties and businesses
* **Drive bookings and upsells**
* **Keep human teammates aligned** across operations
* **Run AI workflows** across the operational lifecycle

One AI-native OS — built so human teams and AI employees can work side by side.

## The AI employees available for hire:

Our AI employees are available across different professions:

* **Gabby** — Guest Experience Manager
* **Claudia** — Cleaning Manager
* **Miles** — Maintenance Manager

* **Quinn** — Quality Inspector
* **Gina** — General Manager
* **Vera** — Virtual Assistant

Hire the ones you need; add more as you scale.

## MCP — bring your own agents

We ship an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, so other AI agents — Claude, ChatGPT, custom in-house agents — can collaborate directly with the ProhostAI AI employees. If you've already built AI workflows, plug them in instead of starting over.

## Why now

The next generation of hospitality companies will be run by human teams working side by side with AI employees. We're starting with short-term rentals because the work is high-volume, repetitive, and deeply operational — exactly where AI teammates make an immediate difference.

From there: vacation rental managers, boutique hotels, broader hospitality and property operations.

## Traction

ProhostAI now supports **8,000+ properties on the platform**, including paid customers and operators using our feature-rich free plan. Founded by a team from **Airbnb, Dropbox, and Guesty** (Harvard + Yale alumni) — and we're property managers ourselves, running a **$12M AUM short-term rental portfolio**. We use ProhostAI every day. Backed by **Y Combinator, Pear VC, and other investors**.

## Our backstory

We've been deep in this space and have watched operators copy-paste the same messages thousands of times, miss calls overnight, lose cleanings to chaos, and string together five tools to do what one OS should handle. We built ProhostAI to make AI employees the new labor layer for hospitality — not another dashboard, not another inbox.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82522&key=user_uploads/32175/b55dcc84-b2d8-4620-a77f-620f8f66d3ff)

**Our vision for a better internet for kids**

As a father, I want to protect my kids at all times and everywhere they go in the world, and in reality, I can’t. But I can build an AI that keeps them safe everywhere they go online and create a “digital Disneyland” for them to play, explore, and connect in.

Like Jarvis to Ironman, Sox to Buzz Lightyear, or Baymax to Hiro, a child is the hero of their own story, and we’re building them the ultimate sidekick. An AI buddy that has their back in the online world, encourages creative play and helps them learn about anything, at any time, in an age-appropriate way.

Soon, hundreds of millions of kids across the globe will connect on the next platform that’s foundationally powered by AI. We’ve seen it coming for a while, and we’re already building that new space… the Genieverse!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82522&key=user_uploads/32175/366ff304-4c16-476d-b7ae-cb271a5249c9)

**Do something fun with Genie today**

**Create**\
Genie is an always-kind, supportive & friendly AI agent that can co-create free-form generative art with kids, and they can create thru other art modes like the “Crazy Food Lab” or “Muppet Monsters.”

**Play**\
Genie can also build incredibly imaginative story worlds where kids decide what happens next or play logic puzzles or word games designed to spark kids’ creative and critical thinking. Genie also knows that kids should have time off of their screens and be active out in the world. When there is available screen time, we built Genie to be engaging and creative.

**Learn**\
The internet is an incredible wealth of knowledge and information, but browsers are binary about whether a kid has access to everything… or nothing. Genie is a safe resource for kids who are curious about the world around them. Sometimes a trusted adult isn’t available to ask, or kids feel weird about asking, so Genie makes sure that tricky questions are answered in kind and age-appropriate ways.

launches.body:
### **Tl;dr:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83411&key=user_uploads/620002/b47c6ed6-17ba-44cf-b061-5a5c4b94ed08)

**ideate.xyz is an AI design co-pilot for content teams to create engaging thumbnail designs for their social media channels. We are starting with thumbnails, the most critical window to connect with audiences - ideate is here to help content teams stand out.**

**Looking ahead, ideate will become THE AI design partner for the next generation of content creators, crafting unique and tailored designs for their bespoke brands.**

### **The team:**

Hi, [Jasper](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jasperjia/) and [Elliott](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ellt92/) here. We are building [ideate.xyz](http://ideate.xyz) - the first AI design co-pilot for content teams to create thumbnail designs for social media channels. 

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcyUiwrYeoWSM9XI-PrkXrpcLxSQZLYZHYRrgKdya2BZpu7VgxyNGx8KcSPqkbuzo0IEUy1_-6sCn3Zsc6cBw0OVQmAUdEJhMmbByvBhOPLvLa4rWe1RTA4lXgk6r_9i2WnQX03jbegL_seQRPUthnvM50C?key=dBDHpbeLdBMcMx4JQU8ppQ)

**Jasper Jia (Left)**

Cofounder & CEO at ideate.xyz. Designer specialising in creative tools and no-code. He believes designers should embrace learning and getting their hands dirty in the technical end of the software building process to craft the best software experience and cultivate fast iteration cycles with the engineering team. He was an ex-Snap designer and MSc Design Engineering graduate from Imperial College London.

**Elliott Thompson (Right)**

Cofounder & CTO at ideate.xyz. A software engineer with a penchant for visual computing. He studied computer graphics at University College London before taking on a role as a graphics generalist at Snap Inc. He has previously worked on 3D engines, game developer tooling, graphics editors, and e-commerce platforms.

### **The problem:**

Design tools are stuck at two extremes: powerful but complex, or simple yet limiting. This seemingly inevitable tradeoff affects millions of content creators trying to stand out with their thumbnail designs, the critical window to connect with their audience.

If you’ve had to design thumbnails for social channels, you've likely been here:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83411&key=user_uploads/620002/b533f0cd-3816-4699-b93b-a445528a046f)

You have a great idea, so you install the latest Adobe product. Suddenly, you're faced with a blank canvas and a dizzying array of options. Hours of YouTube tutorials later, you're ready to throw in the towel.

Time for Plan B. You load up Canva, pick a template that's "close enough," and tweak some colors. It doesn't really feel like yours, and it is so hard to stand out with a “Canva look” when there are over 3.7 million videos uploaded to YouTube alone every day!

### **Our solution:**

[ideate.xyz](http://ideate.xyz) - the first AI design co-pilot orchestrating the entire thumbnail design process from initial ideas to final designs that stand out!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83411&key=user_uploads/620002/56aa1f67-549b-44ae-a3ee-66e0b32c5a17)

\* Design with plain English: No prior experience with design or creative software needed. Produce designs via simple and engaging discussions with AI design co-pilot.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83411&key=user_uploads/620002/406874a3-9435-4c80-9472-f1982d4bb1f7)

\* Think of our copilot as your team’s AI design partner - guiding the design process with proactive questions to understand design requirements and implementing expert design decisions after your sign off.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83411&key=user_uploads/620002/887c967e-b165-4ceb-b4d1-8d5beb9a5bb3)

\* Collaborative environment: Teams can work with a co-pilot on the same project for a quick feedback cycle and sign-off before exporting the final designs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83411&key=user_uploads/620002/3333d422-a852-4af4-8de4-adb7e832c3f8)

\* Maintain brand consistency as our AI learns your preferences over time and always generates content with this in mind.

\* We fine-tune our prompts for each generation, considering layout composition, image assets, and copywriting in lockstep with each other to produce creative but also consistent results. 

A typical workflow with ideate.xyz:

1\. Describe your content ideas

2\. First drafts designed by AI co-pilot

3\. Iterate and create more variations by chatting with AI copilot

4\. Export designs in channel-specific dimensions 

[Quick demo here](https://youtu.be/Zf_i1cUejbk)

### **Our story:**

As a design and engineer duo, we have spent years crafting creative tools in the WebGL and AR space. We've also built and mentored in the no-code space to help non-techies build out their online presence. Regardless of the domain, one challenge persists for creators — finding a design tool that’s both simple and powerful enough to bring a brand's vision to life. The reason why this problem persists in the market is simple - the inevitable tradeoff that every design software needs to make between power and ease of use. Typically, the more powerful a tool gets, the more complex it becomes. On the flip side, easy-to-use tools often limit creativity with rigid templates. 

But with AI, we have found the conviction to break this tradeoff. We are on a mission to create a design tool that actually puts your ideas in the driving seat, making the design process less about esoteric design language and more about the content team’s own creative impulses. Our goal is to empower the next generation of creators to build stunning brands and assets. 

### **Our ask**

Are you currently on a team that regularly has to come up with thumbnail designs for your social media content?  Either wrestling with complex design tools or unhappy with generic templates? Talk to us, and we would love to learn more about your requirements!

If you know any professional content creators, we’d really appreciate the connection!

Our email is [founders@ideate.xyz](mailto:founders@ideate.xyz)

launches.title: Proxis - the first dedicated platform for LLM distillation and serving
launches.tagline: Model serving optimizations to reduce compute costs.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** [Proxis](https://www.proxis.ai/) is the first dedicated platform for LLM distillation and serving, unlocking production ready models at 1/10th of the cost.

### The Problem

* Fine-tuning frontier models like GPT-4 on proprietary data is expensive, and locks customers into one external closed source model provider. 
* These large models are 100x the price per-token of smaller Llama 3.1 models, and run nearly 10x slower. This makes them impractical to deploy at scale.
* Closed source model lock-in means customers can’t tweak or tune their own model, or deploy on-prem for sensitive data solutions. 

### The Solution

Model Distillation:

* In model distillation, a large **teacher model** effectively fine tunes a smaller **student model** without the need for _labeled_ or _structured_ datasets. This ‘condenses’ large models down to the compute cost of small models.
* Distillation results in near-frontier model quality, with efficient performance. This means we can achieve 5x the speed at 1/10th the cost.
* With the release of Llama 405b in late July, open source frontier distillation became available to the public for the first time. 

### Growth & Market

* Llama model downloads have grown 10x in the last year and are approaching 350 million downloads to date. There were 20 million downloads in the last month alone, making Llama the leading open source model family.
* Llama usage by token volume across major cloud service providers has more than doubled in just three months from May through July 2024 when Llama 3.1 was released.
* Monthly usage (token volume) of Llama grew 10x from January to July 2024 for some of the largest cloud service providers.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdQSaqElsFW5E2grv46IezSDDiWOQKb8xcXqzf9FzWYnY8s0DywELRQaJpXNRWRxIqFsJwL_Nt_eJawi2BaNk-QasNFOv0tm8efkn3DwhfxHqH-8jizsSQMZnZiGW3yfBZNHdWz9lVME9vuxqcbBp_kETp4?key=EmGuREnt2lr1tUSBSUm-SQ)

Source: [Meta](https://ai.meta.com/blog/llama-usage-doubled-may-through-july-2024/)

### The Team

[Jackson](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jacksonstokes/) (CTO, on the left) **optimized the Gemini model at Google** for efficient deployment at massive scale. [Liam](https://www.linkedin.com/in/liam-collins-/) (CEO, on the right) built zero-to-one systems as a software engineer.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83633&key=user_uploads/1592615/ea47fdba-f119-4680-8d1e-e394d6e85273)

### The Ask

Give it a go! Sign up to our waitlist [here](http://www.proxis.ai/) to access Proxis-hosted Llama models at a cheaper cost than current offerings.

name: Storia AI
long_description:
With AI increasingly automating away code generation, software engineers will spend more time reading, judging, and architecting code rather than writing it. Storia is building an open-source copilot that knows a company's codebase and its context.

We are starting with Sage, a Perplexity-like agent for helping developers understand, judge, and generate software. Given an existing codebase, developers can ask Sage questions such as:
1) Given my project’s SLA and latency constraints, what is the appropriate underlying vector database to use? How would I incorporate it into my existing codebase?
2) Why should I pick Redis over Milvus as my underlying vector store?
3) Does this codebase in our organization still work and what steps are required for a complex integration with another library?

Sage’s answers are directly supported by documentation and external references like GitHub, Stack Overflow, technical design documents, and project management software, preventing hallucinations. Today, Sage has up-to-date knowledge about open-source repositories (indexed daily). Tomorrow it will have a deep understanding of every line of code on the Internet. For teams, Sage will know about your private codebase too.

No group has yet solved how to build an AI system that comprehends a codebase and its context and can empower every developer to architect better code, faster. This requires new research advances because vanilla RAG and out-of-the-box LLMs aren’t going to cut it. 

We have 20+ years of software engineering and AI research experience. Julia worked on precursors of Gemini using contextual neural techniques before they were called “RAG” (and applied it to products like Google Keyboard and Pixel phones). Mihail built the earliest LLMs at Amazon Alexa and launched the first contextual deep learning conversational AI system in production at Alexa.
one_liner: Open source AI copilot that knows your company's code and its context

launches.title: Storia: A contextual AI pair programmer for developer teams
launches.tagline: We help engineering teams understand, analyze, and generate software with their codebases.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83405&key=user_uploads/812126/ce70880c-852a-4e80-a573-88f6742298ed)

Hi everyone. We’re Julia and Mihail, the team behind [Storia](https://storia.ai/?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch-yc). We have 20+ years of software engineering and AI research experience. [Julia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/iulia-raluca-turc/) worked on precursors of Gemini using contextual neural techniques before they were called “RAG” (and applied it to products like Google Keyboard and Pixel phones). [Mihail](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mihaileric/) built the earliest LLMs at Amazon Alexa and launched the first contextual deep-learning conversational AI system in production at Alexa.

**👎 The Problem: <5% of software teams use AI code understanding and generation systems**

Despite all the hype around AI coding following the release of GitHub Copilot, a disappointingly small percentage of engineering teams have actually adopted AI assistants into their developer workflows. Why?

What developers don’t like about systems today:

1. **Code search is not accurate enough**, slowing dev velocity.
2. **Code assistants are not grounded in their team’s codebase**, so they lack the necessary context to produce useful and high-quality answers.
3. **Code outputs can be incorrect** due to hallucination which strains dev patience and trust.

**🚀 The Solution: A contextual AI pair programmer built for any team’s codebase**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83405&key=user_uploads/812126/0e093af4-4352-4550-a123-be44cf3dc747)

We’re building [Sage](https://sage.storia.ai/?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch-yc), a Perplexity-like agent for helping developers understand, analyze, and generate software. Given an existing codebase, developers can ask Sage questions such as:

* _For my project’s SLA and latency constraints, what is the appropriate underlying vector database to use? How would I incorporate it into my existing codebase?_
* _Why should I pick Redis over Milvus as my underlying vector store?_
* _Does this codebase in our organization still work, and what steps are required for an integration with another library?_

A few of the features Sage supports:

* **We index repos daily**, providing users with the most up-to-date info about how to use a library (no stale, deprecated API definitions),
* We have a Perplexity-like focus on **citing the source of every generated line of code**, enhancing developer trust.
* We've developed algorithms grounded in research for **syntactic and semantic understanding of a codebase** so that we can provide more relevant context and use it effectively given a user query.

 We are now actively working with seed to series C partner companies to help them integrate Sage into their developer workflows. 

**🌅 The Opportunity: Making every engineer on a software team a 10x developer**

There are \~28M developers worldwide. Github Copilot is the frontrunner in AI assistant tooling and reached $100M ARR in 2 years, which is only a small percentage of the $913B spent on software development in 2023.

**🙏 Our Ask**\
We’re still onboarding a closed group of beta partners to integrate with Sage. We would appreciate connecting with engineering leaders (VP of engineering, Head of Engineering, CTO)  at Seed-Series C companies. 

Additionally, if you want your open-source repository indexed reach out to us at [mihail@storia.ai.](mailto:founders@storia.ai)

launches.title: Tivara 🏥💰 — Automating insurance approval workflows for doctors
launches.tagline: See patients faster by automating your prior authorization requests.
launches.body:
[Tivara](https://tivara.com/)’s mission is to help doctors deliver care to patients faster. We’re starting by using LLMs to automate submitting prior authorization requests (and getting their approval) on behalf of providers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82570&key=user_uploads/758190/5152c520-617b-4e43-82e4-5cac7c301950)

## What is Prior Authorization, and Why Should I Care?

Prior authorization is a process by which physicians must justify their treatment plan of a patient to that patient’s health insurance carrier as “medically necessary.” 

Right now, medical groups employ a team (1 employee focused on prior authorizations per 1-5 physicians) to handle this process with insurance carriers manually. These teams are frequently operating over capacity; some of the practices we’ve talked to are so backlogged that a request isn’t even submitted until up to a week after a doctor’s order is placed.

**Figure 1: 94% of Physicians Report Delayed Patient Care due to Prior Authorization (Source: American Medical Association Survey of 1,000 Doctors)**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82570&key=user_uploads/758190/7ccd172e-a4be-4e61-962d-916b4de1491d)

As you can imagine, insurance carriers are incentivized to delay and/or deny approval as much as they can. Some carriers are so egregious that they’re incurring fines in the tens of millions for morbidly delaying the care of sick patients. A patient who is exhibiting signs of colon cancer definitely shouldn’t have to wait months (or even days) for a colonoscopy.

At the end of the day, we do two things:

1. Help doctors deliver care faster
2. Make doctors more money (reduce OpEx)

## Who we are:

Great friends from college.

[Tej](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tej-seelamsetty/) – Ran growth (10x-ed revenue) at Fair Square (W20) and was an AC at Bain. Paid for college by flipping houses. Studied CS at WashU.

[Aumesh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aumesh-misra) – Ex-Microsoft and was the 8th engineer at Compound (S19). Built medical imaging software used by Stanford. Also studied CS at WashU.

## Our ask

Are your parents, siblings, or extended family members doctors who run their own practice? You can help us with an introduction! Please shoot [tej@tivara.com](mailto:tej@tivara.com) a note.

launches.tagline: 💡 Gauge helps your company show up in more AI answers
launches.body:
**Gauge helps your company show up more in AI answers.**

### ⚠️ Why should you care?

* [Google searches are falling for the first time ever](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/ais-threat-to-google-just-got-real-8280b4ee?utm_source=chatgpt.com) ([and Google itself is moving to AI answers](https://www.theverge.com/news/655930/google-q1-2025-earnings))
* [Gartner predicts AI chatbots will capture 25% of search volume by next year](https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2024-02-19-gartner-predicts-search-engine-volume-will-drop-25-percent-by-2026-due-to-ai-chatbots-and-other-virtual-agents)

With traffic leaving search, traditional SEO is dying. Our customers are seeing inbound AI traffic **double every quarter**.

### 💡How do we help?

We measure how often you and your competitors are referenced by AI, and derive insights from changes in the data over time.

Let’s take a look at how this works:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HPXcshLuQD4

We came across this problem through an Open Source Day hosted by YC. There, we heard from a huge range of speakers, including Vercel, Elastic, Resend, and Airbyte. A consistent theme across every speaker was the new inbound they were seeing from ChatGPT.

We decided to run an experiment: [productrank.ai](http://productrank.ai).

[productrank.ai](http://productrank.ai) lets you search for a topic, and see how the top models rank them. [Check it out here!](https://productrank.ai)

launches.body:
Hey 👋 I’m Robert, founder of Stormy.

We’re building Stormy because influencer marketing is still spreadsheets, manual DMs, and endless negotiations with influencers. In a world of “AI SDRs,” you should be able to describe your campaign once and have the AI agent just work for you while you sleep. Growing your business while you focus on the tech.

We recently won **Product Hunt Product of the Day**, and YC founders + agencies are already using Stormy to run micro- and nano-influencer campaigns end-to-end.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jK_8i8Wd0iQ&t=1s

### How does it work?

Type a brief; Stormy handles the pipeline:

1. **Describe your ideal creators**\
   “US-based AI YouTubers talking about agents, 10–100k subs” → Stormy searches YouTube & TikTok, podcasts, etc., and verifies each match.
2. **One-click contacts**\
   Grab real emails in bulk (bio, site, press pages) and enrich profiles.
3. **AI Negotiator**\
   Connect your Gmail and TikTok account to personalize outreach, automatic follow-ups, price extraction, and counter-offers within your budget guardrails—logged to a lightweight CRM.
4. **Close & track**\
   Mark deals, export assets, and keep everything in one place (performance tracking integrations coming).

### Who’s it for?

* **Founders/In-house Growth** at AI & consumer apps who want predictable creator acquisition
* **Agencies** running lots of small collabs (micro/nano) and are sick of manual workflows
* **Creators/brands** who need a simple way to scale outreach without scaling headcount

### Why now?

Creator supply is exploding; attention is fragmented. Winning brands are those that can operationalize many small deals, fast. Stormy turns the “thousand tiny tasks” of influencer ops into a clean, automated flow.

### What’s next?

* **Promote UGC with TikTok Ads** — Spark/allowlisting in one click with budget guardrails and auto-variants.
* **Payments & Tracking** — creator payouts, contracts/usage windows, and performance attribution (UTM, Appsflyer, PostHog) per asset.
* **Unified Influencer → Performance CRM** — one pipeline from discovery & negotiation to ROAS/LTV.
* **Always-on Outreach (“Auto-campaigns”)** — human-in-the-loop sequences to keep the funnel full.
* **Light UGC Workflows** — simple briefs and clip collection (no heavy studio), with templates and QA for consistency.

Questions—or interested in learning more? Email [**robert@stormy.ai**](mailto:robert@stormy.ai)

launches.title: Lighthouz AI: AI to automate collections for freight brokers and 3PLs
launches.tagline: Freight brokers and 3PLs collect what they're owed 5-8 days faster — without adding headcount to AR
launches.body:
Freight brokers and 3PLs run lean accounting teams that spend their days chasing money that's already earned. Every unpaid invoice means emailing a customer, checking a portal, following up again a week later, and manually deciding which accounts are actually at risk — work that scales linearly with headcount and doesn't get easier as a book of business grows. DSO creeps up not because customers refuse to pay, but because no one has time to chase every invoice consistently.

Lighthouz built Lucie, an AI collections agent purpose-built for freight finance. Lucie works customer accounts the way a best-in-class AR analyst would, just continuously and across every account at once:

* Email Collections Agent — drafts and sends context-aware payment reminders and follow-ups, escalating tone as invoices age
* Portal Collections Agent — logs into customer payment portals to check status and submit documentation, so nothing stalls waiting on a portal check
* Collections Work Queue — surfaces the accounts that actually need a human, with full context, instead of a flat list of overdue invoices
* AR Risk Dashboard — flags at-risk accounts early using payment-behavior signals, before they become write-offs

Every action Lucie takes is visible to the AR team, with clear ownership indicators showing what's automated and what's waiting on a person — collections teams stay in control of the relationship, they just stop doing the busywork.

Founders:

Srijan and Sonali are married co-founders who met at IIT during undergrad and bring 15+ years of combined AI and supply chain experience. Srijan was a CS professor at Georgia Tech, a former Google research scientist, and a Stanford postdoc with 60+ publications. Sonali spent a decade as an AI/data engineer in fintech and insurance, including at Halliburton, Progressive, and American Family.

Key Metrics:

* DSO reduction: 5-8 days faster to collect
* 30%-50% reduction in overdues 
* 45% of collections touches now automated
* One AR specialist manages 2x more accounts

Traction:

Lighthouz already powers finance operations of 40+ freight brokers and 3PLs, including Hoplite Logistics, Southern Reins Logistics, ADL, and NAD Logistics. Lighthouz AI has won the TIA 2025 and 2026 Technovator Awards.

launches.title: Lighthouz AI: AI to automate AP and AR for freight brokers and 3PLs
launches.tagline: 3PLs invoice customers within 24 hours of delivery & get paid 5 days faster
launches.body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SNdu7kqN0MY

Freight brokers and 3PLs still run AP and AR manually.

Accounting teams spend days processing carrier bills, chasing missing PODs, delaying customer invoicing, and collections efforts. Cash flow stagnates. Before Lighthouz, teams typically take 3–5 days to approve carrier bills and send customer invoices — and still miss errors like duplicate payments and invalid accessorials.

**At Lighthouz, we’ve built freight-native AI agents to automate AP and AR for brokers and 3PLs. With Lighthouz, brokers are invoicing customers within 24 hours of delivery and reduce days-to-get-paid by 5 days.** 

### **Who we are**

We’re **Srijan and Sonali**, the founders of **Lighthouz AI**. We’re part of YC S24. 

We met a decade ago during undergrad at **IIT**, have been building together ever since, and have been married for 5+ years. Srijan and Sonali have 15+ years of combined experience in AI and supply chain, building AI systems for companies like Halliburton, The Home Depot, Google, and more. 

* **Srijan** an award-winning AI scientist with **60+ publications and 6,000+ citations**.  He’s been a **CS professor at Georgia Tech**, an **ex-research scientist at Google**, completed his **postdoc at Stanford**, and earned his **PhD from the University of Maryland**.
* **Sonali** is a former **Lead AI Engineer** at **Halliburton**, **Progressive Insurance, and American Family**, specializing in **unstructured data** and building production-grade AI systems from scratch. She earned her **MS from the University of Washington**.

We’ve spent our careers building and deploying AI for complex, messy real-world data — which is exactly what freight finance looks like.

### **What Lighthouz AI does**

Lighthouz handles the entire freight billing workflow:

✅ Ingests **carrier bills, PODs, BOLs, lumpers, and invoices** from email and uploads

✅ Extracts and structures **all freight data** — rates, accessorials, remit-to, signatures, handwritten notes

✅ Verifies carrier bills against **rate confirmations / quotes**

✅ Detects exceptions like **duplicates, overbilling, missing PODs, wrong factors, and invalid accessorials**

✅ Auto-approves clean bills and routes **only true exceptions**

✅ Approves and submits **customer invoices within 24 hours of delivery**

✅ Sends automated **collections reminders** to customers pre- and post-due date 

✅ Creates a work queue for human collectors 

✅ Posts clean, validated data directly into the **TMS with full audit trails**

### **Why this matters**

Manual AP/AR quietly kills cash flow in freight. Before Lighthouz, teams typically take **3–5 days** to approve carrier bills and send customer invoices — and still miss errors like duplicate payments and invalid accessorials.

With Lighthouz:

* Processing time drops from **3–5 days → <24 hours**
* Days to get payment from customers reduces by 5 days 
* One AP specialist can process **4–5x more volume**
* Errors and rework drop dramatically
* Teams scale without adding headcount

This isn’t generic automation. Lighthouz is freight-native, built for multi-stop loads, multi-document PDFs, missing pages, rotated scans, handwritten notes, and factoring response workflows.

### **Where we are**

We are already working with leading freight brokers and 3PLs in the US and Canada. 

**Ask** ❤️

If you know freight brokers or 3PLs, please introduce us!

launches.tagline: MagiCode anticipates developers’ needs and offers them active guidance.
launches.body:
**TLDR:**

[MagiCode](https://www.magicode.ai/) is a **proactive** AI pair programmer that intuitively understands developers' actions in real-time, actively anticipates their next steps, and offers assistance even before they ask.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdi0SQOOv0alhPERCWVCENvw7nB-U00PP82FQpevrGFc4QLGSwd53sQQ7E0FR5Vomx_GZxdx_9fflyHAWQi1-nJpg-L1KfwOqf-xvYbVInucv5T-rYfH0sqeIuhzU1xMsjgbbUvewcy7J0_2SqrGUWTWZzj?key=IP7Rk802TWBSSnOAUrqnyQ)

**Why are we building this? ⚙️**

We were active users of various AI coding tools even before they were named “pair programmers”. However, the experience was underwhelming because: 

1. they are **not really “intelligent”**: we always had to type out multiple shortcuts for our queries to be routed to the right AI agent to handle. 
2. when we were deeply immersed in a task/implementation, we often didn’t know **how, or what** to ask the AI Coding tool. For example, when implementing a button that triggers a POST/ request to the backend API, we have to constantly jump around multiple files, making modifications across different functions. In this scenario, before asking the AI to help us with implementation, we actually have to spend time thinking about “how” to frame our questions:

 

* How do we explain what the functionality of this button is? 
* Which file names should we mention to the AI as being relevant? 
* How can we succinctly phrase all relevant context, including current progress or past edits/changes that we have made, so that the AI will give us the best output?

As a result, we often resorted to doing everything ourselves to avoid the tedious back-and-forth. 

In those moments, we realized what we wanted was a tool that could **fetch global context** without relying on shortcut commands, anticipate our needs, and even understand what we were thinking before typing anything— something that was always **“on the same page”** with us. That’s exactly what led us to create MagiCode— a tool that can answer all the developer’s questions intelligently, and also **proactively assist** without needing to be prompted.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcgtDCwIm0PlMe_DCSQip8X8jXRnbAeLD9SCjhBN43ZcTRbnyfl8Mhi3WTfOVJyXwaYO50Ef2ZZtGPcq8bKngNnBgc0071stmvyCd1HdlYlJUVJfKNLKGT1IWpoLmX9B2GroQSiBhGjQj3sS7reml024gq1?key=IP7Rk802TWBSSnOAUrqnyQ)

**How are we different from existing solutions? 🤔**

* **Proactive Assistance:** We bring the answers to you without you even asking. MagiCode is designed to constantly analyze the project's state and make suggestions for what you can do next. As a user, all you have to do is click on a suggestion and watch as MagiCode works on files asynchronously and brings you the finalized results with easy-to-view diff files. 
* **Personalized Memory:**  We have personalized memory retainment of your editing history, editor state, and user activity. We designed an intelligent system that processes all this information in a low-latency manner and uses it naturally when answering the user’s queries.

### **Watch MagiCode in action! 🤯**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EPM_eOL8BRE

### **Our ask 🙏**

We are currently onboarding users for MagiCode. 

* If you’d love to try MagiCode, we are active on **Discord** and would be happy to help you onboard and answer any questions. You can join our discord here: https://discord.gg/tqveBrwd 
* If you know an engineer who is interested in trying out AI Coding tools, tell them about MagiCode! 
* You can also reach out to us directly at [hello@magicode.ai](mailto:hello@magicode.ai) to talk more about the future of AI-powered coding. Feel free to book a time with us here: https://www.magicode.ai/book-a-demo/ 😊

launches.body:
**TL;DR**: [Asterisk](https://asterisk.so/) is an AI “hacker” with the ability to find, exploit, and patch security loopholes across your digital assets. It does all of this with no user intervention and generates a report with zero false positives. ([example](https://demo.asterisk.so/?report_id=776e01e4-22a2-44bd-afc5-229ec115e1b1))

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82844&key=user_uploads/629782/0cd6877d-6d46-4428-ae29-236edb91393e)

# **The Problem**

* Almost 95% of potential vulnerabilities raised by static security tools (SAST) are **false positives**, and security engineers spend a lot of time filtering them out.
* Current security tech **cannot detect business logic bugs** - think of vulnerabilities like unauthorized access, privilege escalation, and bugs that would rack up your AWS/API bills.

# **Solution**

* **Verification:** Asterisk verifies a vulnerability by spinning up a sandbox, running the software being scanned, and attempts to exploit the bug. If Asterisk flags a vulnerability, you can be sure it's real.
* **Context-aware Threat Modeling:** Asterisk understands your codebase and can thus emulate a malicious hacker by coming up with attack scenarios, like the recent CrowdStrike incident.

# **Our Team**

We are [Mufeed](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mufeed-vh/), [Asjid](https://www.linkedin.com/in/asjidkalam/) and [Vivek](https://www.linkedin.com/in/123vivekr/). All of us have a background in security research and systems engineering.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82844&key=user_uploads/629782/4120e7a5-43bf-4fa1-9352-699f902b32c9)

**Mufeed**: represented 🇮🇳 at WorldSkills CTF, 🥇 medalist - IndiaSkills CTF, 🥉 medalist - BRICS Skills CTF

**Asjid**: 🥈 medalist - IndiaSkills, ex-security research engineer at Emirates National Bank (UAE)

**Vivek**: ex-distributed systems/platforms engineer at Chorus One (one of the biggest POS validators)

Our team has helped secure Google, Mastercard, Okta, Nvidia, Microsoft, etc. We are also the team behind [Devika,](https://github.com/stitionai/devika) the open-source alternative to Devin with over 18K stars on GitHub.

# **Our Ask**

If you're looking for a **complete security audit** of your digital assets or want to talk about anything security, email us ([hello@asterisk.so](mailto:hello@asterisk.so)) or book a demo ([asterisk.so/demo](http://asterisk.so/demo)).

The result? Lower operation costs, higher product quality, and a smoother production line.

🍁 = 🤖 + 🏭 + 📊

### **Problem - Advanced Machines, Outdated Infrastructure**

The adoption of robots in manufacturing is exploding, especially to keep up with producing increasingly more complex products and shortages in skilled labor. However, the infrastructure in which these robots would be deployed is still years behind.

Without effective systems, manufacturing physical products might seem like an insurmountable black box, especially when they are made in factories on another continent where critical information is only reported via spreadsheets every other week.

Autumn Labs is already monitoring and managing 50+ automated factory stations in 4 different consumer electronics factory lines across multiple companies and contract manufacturers. There’s a good chance that a product you use today has gone through our platform.

Why our customers love us:

1. Clear insights into Manufacturing Value Added (MVA) costs
2. Increased machine utilization
3. Rapid improvements in production quality
4. Enhanced product development cycles

launches.title: 🏭🤖 Distro - Bringing point-of-sale AI to industrial distribution
launches.tagline: The AI co-pilot for sales reps at industrial wholesale distributors.
launches.body:
[Distro](https://distro.app/) is the AI sales co-pilot designed for industrial wholesale distributors. We created Distro out of a passion for developing software for the “real economy,” and in particular for the trades. The Distro team is based in, and loves, NYC! 🗽

### 😅 **The Problem**

Distributors, particularly those mid-size and smaller, face a long list of point-of-sale challenges these days.

_🧠 Brain drain_: the most experienced reps are at or near retirement and are taking a great deal of tribal knowledge with them.

_🔧 Complex sales_: quoting entire systems, load calculations, replacing legacy parts and equipment.

_📦 Inventory challenges_: growing SKU counts, supply chain disruptions, decreased inventorying by contractors.

_🎓 Training and retention_: counter reps, in particular, are difficult to hire, train and retain.

These issues are amplified by the increasing importance of counter and inside sales relative to the rest of the sales organization–there has been a whopping 13 percentage point shift\* towards counter staff and inside sales influencing purchasing decisions, moving away from territory managers/outside sales.

To top it all off, there is the ever-present and growing threat of larger players that have the resources to throw money and bodies at the aforementioned problems.

_\*_ 2023-2024 State of the Channel, HARDI (Heating, Air-conditioning & Refrigeration Distributors International)

### 🔍 **Our Approach**

What began as an academic curiosity about how to apply AI to distribution evolved into our team spending countless hours with distributor reps across the country over the course of a year, going deep on their day-to-day challenges, and building a distributor-centric solution from the ground up in partnership with several leading distributors. 

This experience–fully immersing ourselves in a distribution vertical in order to go far beyond a superficial understanding of that vertical’s product universe and sales workflows–has shaped our product philosophy and overall approach. Some of our learnings:

📍 _Meet reps where they are_: don’t try to push reps to adapt to a totally new paradigm. Adapt our workflows to how things really work at the counter.

🚀 _Effortless onboarding_: distributor IT teams don’t need another tech project to distract them. Build solutions that avoid the need for long implementations.

🔒 _Data sanctity_: distributors can spend a lot of time, energy, and money curating their data. Complete data security and privacy are necessary to protect that advantage.

🛠️ _Enhance, don’t replace_: the human element is the key to a distributor’s value-add to its contractor customers. We’re building Iron Man’s suit, not the Terminator.

### 💡 **Our Solution**

Our platform helps counter and inside sales reps work more efficiently by transforming complex customer requests into real-time product information and quotes. With Distro, reps can quote faster, boost conversion rates, and increase customer retention. We support distributors in sectors like HVAC/R, plumbing, electrical, and more.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
For years we worked side by side at Palantir, building with some of the largest industrial companies on the continent. Leopold led the established customer business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Marvin owned and deployed the first instances of what became the Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP). Together we shipped projects that turned into more than €50M in new revenue.

In summer 2024 we left. We had seen what forward-deployed engineers do for large enterprises, and one thing kept showing up: the people who actually run a business, the heads of controlling, the buyers, the plant managers, are still moving data by hand. The signal sits in the ERP, in the CRM, and in a dozen tools that do not talk to each other. So decisions get made in spreadsheets and on gut feel. The gap between the two is where companies lose time, money and confidence.

With today’s frontier models that work can finally be done at software scale. So we are building the autonomous data engineer for the mid-market. ZeitMind connects SAP, your ERP, CRM, HR systems and 600+ other sources, prepares the messy data, and turns everyday business questions into live dashboards, reports and applications, all in natural language.

We joined Y Combinator in S24, put it in front of real controlling, procurement and supply chain teams, and went from zero to €1M ARR in twelve months with six people, customers live in weeks and no IT support needed. Today we are 12 engineers, builders and operators across Munich and London.

launches.title: 📈💡Zeit AI: Insights from your tabular data with just a few words
launches.tagline: Connect your ERP, CRM, CSVs to query them with natural language. 🗂️✅💬
launches.body:
### **🏆 TLDR**

[Zeit AI](https://www.zeit-ai.com/) is ChatGPT for enterprise tables. You can sync tables from your data bases, ERP systems, CRMs, CSVs and more. Atop of these tables, simple questions in natural language can be used to locate data, combine it, generate analyses, or even charts. All results are repeatable and explainable. They can be exported at the click of a button. [Watch our demo!](https://youtu.be/u3NcYh4zCz4)

# 🧑‍💻🌟 **The Team**

Together, [Marvin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mcbornstein/) and [Leopold](https://www.linkedin.com/in/v-waldthausen/) have over 15 years of combined experience in data engineering and analytics. During our four years side-by-side at Palantir, we led high-impact projects, building an AI rule-engine and generating over €50 million in novel project revenue. We saw first-hand how corporates heavily relied on Excel files, leading to manual work to analyse and combine data. A solution like Zeit AI would have been a game-changer in accessing this data at scale.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83344&key=user_uploads/1927760/4024d05f-c883-4ea7-8053-a6e3eb0fdf7b)

# ⚠️ **Problem**

Non-technical users find it challenging to access and analyse enterprise data. Yet, making data-driven decisions is crucial in today’s fast-paced world.

1. Data is stored in files rather than structured databases.
2. Databases cannot be accessed by non-technical users.
3. Data often needs to be exported and manually combined in Excel.

# 💡 **Solution**

Zeit AI allows non-technical users to derive ad-hoc insights from tables using natural language. This is possible in just three steps.

1. Sync data files directly from your source systems (We support data bases, ERP, CRM and even CSV uploads).

**Tl;dr:** Parley helps immigration lawyers write visa applications using AI. We integrate directly into a lawyer’s typical workflow so they can start writing with Parley from day 1 and deliver results to their clients faster.\
—

Hi everyone, we’re Jackson, Philip, and Ian, and we’re the co-founders of [Parley](http://www.parley.so).

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdt6N9Q8vNdjiG9xxDpkQcK7DC6o2oJ1pXc5CeFeNpU2jR8qqIb_HbbsvKCgbOuoHmlHJKSF1Y3cnlKz0SCU2BWfICIW3sVsxtv2MV5POsxXUBkkqgYH2Rzq1YRLdcm9rTZf4rLxt6pCFzt6-DOYN-A2yKY?key=bRVaeO2Jsn5Nds8A8Ue9KA)

**📚 The Problem**

It’s no secret that the immigration system in the U.S. is broken. Anyone pursuing a work or immigrant visa will tell you about the difficulties of lottery systems, exorbitant fees, and endless paperwork. 

At Parley, we believe an important piece to fixing this process is **automating work for immigration firms.** For some visa types, a lawyer or legal writer spends several days writing a single application, learning about the most complex and technical professions, collating hundreds of pages of evidence, and synthesizing it all into a cohesive petition. Meanwhile, an applicant eagerly waits for their opportunity. By helping lawyers work better on a daily basis, we hope to accelerate Parley’s speed to impact — reducing the complexity of immigration.

**✍️ The Solution** 

Parley makes immigration processes easier. Our first product, the O-1A Writer, helps **immigration attorneys speed write a petition** while keeping them in the loop. As a lawyer does the critical thinking in specifying what argument they want to make, our writer dynamically pulls content from an applicant's evidence, fits that material to the context of the application, and automatically drafts a petition for review. We do this all directly in Microsoft Word — where most attorneys spend their time writing. We’re quickly expanding support for more visa types like the H-1B, TN, EB-1, EB-2 NIW, L-1, and more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81798&key=user_uploads/410497/9ed0f8d6-b11f-48a8-acc1-3a6d50fb74df)

* **Like what we’re building?** Share this post! Spread the word to help us build toward the vision of making immigration simple.
