launches.body:
[Surge is the easiest way for developers to send and receive text messages.](https://youtu.be/3cTyfiw5jtE)

# **The Problem**

It used to be easy to start texting with Twilio and other APIs, but after recent carrier compliance changes, you have to jump through hoops and piece together fragmented documentation to get registered. Then you still have to wait 2-3 weeks for approval before you can actually send messages.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85595&key=user_uploads/97400/2bd7755f-cbb7-4d0d-ad1f-bfd7f8804db9)

The big SMS APIs are all now focused on big companies paying them millions of dollars per year. Startups are left with a terrible user experience, unresponsive email support, and a feeling of helplessness when trying to add SMS functionality to our applications.

# **Our Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85595&key=user_uploads/97400/17af9950-2bdc-46d5-b7ae-83f4194fbd42)

By incorporating the new compliance standards into our product from the beginning, Surge lets developers send texts without having to become experts on the registration process first. We provide white glove onboarding to get you through carrier registration or toll-free verification, and we can do it in 1-2 business days (sometimes even same day) instead of the typical 2-3 weeks. And we can get you up and running with a trial in minutes.

Our intuitive REST API and webhooks are designed at a higher level of abstraction than other providers, which helps you simplify your application logic. And if you’d rather write as little code as possible, we even have embeddable low-code UI components that make two-way texting a breeze to set up. On top of that, we offer responsive support to help you figure out any issues you have, no matter your size.

# **Our Team**

[Dennis](https://linkedin.com/in/dnsbty) and [Brett](https://www.linkedin.com/in/brett-t-beatty) are brothers who spent a combined 11 years at Podium (W16) where they worked on communications infrastructure for small businesses. Brett was a senior engineer on the Phones product, and Dennis was a tech lead and senior engineer on the Messenger platform. We’re excited to be building together, and to be taking on a problem that has caused so much frustration for developers like us.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85595&key=user_uploads/97400/b94153ab-d83e-404b-a1d8-be5068d37906)

If you’re currently using Twilio or another SMS API, please reach out! Even if you have no interest in switching providers, we would love to hear about your experience. [Book time on my calendar](https://cal.com/team/surge/sms-chat-from-yc-launch), or reach out to [ycdirectory@surgemsg.com.](mailto:ycdirectory@surgemsg.com)

**TL;DR:** [**Ryvn**](https://ryvn.ai) **_empowers SaaS startups to seamlessly deploy, monitor, and manage their applications within customer clouds_** _and on-premises environments. We streamline on-prem delivery with integrated logging, monitoring, and simplified updates and rollbacks across all customer installations._ [_Watch our demo_](https://youtu.be/1wTY1a0KKPU)

   
 
# **🔥 The Team**

[Albert](https://www.linkedin.com/in/simplyalam/) and [Shardool](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sp97/) collectively bring over a decade of expertise in infrastructure and DevOps.

At Palantir, Shardool led engineering teams building deployment infrastructure for managing **hundreds of environments**, including cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped systems—facilitating over 10,000 deploys per day.

Albert led engineering teams at Palantir, developing disaster prevention products that secured $xxM in contracts. At Capital One, he architected modular deployment pipelines and resource management tools.

   
 
# **❌ The Problem**

**Building infra is not building product**\
Setting up infrastructure for each customer—learning tools like Terraform and Kubernetes, creating configurations, and making Docker images—is time-consuming. Instead of building new features, your team is tied up with these tasks just to get deployments working.

**Customer DevOps slows you down**\
If you're sending code, docker images, or Helm charts to customers, you're relying on their DevOps team to prioritize your updates and correctly follow installation instructions. This can lead to **delays of 4-6 weeks** before updates are applied, hurting your delivery cycle.

**Support sucks without monitoring and logging**\
Hearing about outages or bugs over email or Slack leaves you scrambling to react, putting customer trust at risk. Secure access to logs and metrics is critical to providing reliable service.

   
 
# **🔮 Our Solution**

**🚢 Easily Install and Ship Updates**\
Ryvn handles on-prem and VPC deployments automatically from your GitHub code, like Vercel, allowing you to push updates **multiple times a day** with little to no customer involvement.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85379&key=user_uploads/1690248/a32c6ee9-98c9-4289-b62f-83ec48cda238)
 \
**🎮 Controlled Updates & Instant Rollbacks**\
Roll out updates with ease across release stages, including **instant rollbacks** to previous stable versions, ensuring uptime and customer confidence.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85379&key=user_uploads/1690248/a6862582-b463-415b-9239-39ff5d161cf0)
 \
**👁️ Integrated Logging & Monitoring**\
Secure, **centralized access to logs** and health metrics across customer environments. Logs are streamed to your cloud or accessible on-demand from your customer’s cloud.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85379&key=user_uploads/1690248/1bffb4e3-5a28-44d0-a75c-8e92ebf639d6)

   
 
# **💭 Why Deploy to Customer Clouds?**

**💸 Charge more, bigger markets**

* Charge **3–10x** more for customer cloud / on-prem deployments
* Sell to regulated industries — health, finance, enterprise, etc.

**🥷 Skip the security review & SOC 2**

* Land **PoCs** _faster_ by deploying on-prem to bypass lengthy security reviews
* You don’t need SOC 2 or HIPAA to deploy on-prem

**❤️ Make your bank and lawyers happy**

* Customers pay directly for infrastructure cost
* Not hosting customer data reduces your liability

launches.tagline: Relvy looks at application logs and metrics to detect and debug issues, so engineers don’t have to.
launches.body:
Hi, we are Bharath Bhat and Simranjit Singh. We are building Relvy AI.

### ❗ The problem

* Companies spend $35B annually paying engineers to be on-call, and yet continue to suffer from $$$$ outages.
* Monitoring production software is hard.
* Engineering teams are always playing catch up - either flying blind with no alerts, or drowning in alert noise.

 

### ⭐ Introducing Relvy

With Relvy, you can just say “**Hey Relvy, monitor my logs for me**”. Relvy connects to your observability stack to detect and debug any issues that show up. It takes less than 5 minutes to set up Relvy to monitor your logs and get actionable alerts WITH a root cause analysis.

[Demo Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j_8wLDFMGNM)

### ⚙️ How it works

* You connect Relvy to your observability tools and provide a set of log queries that you’d want to monitor
* Relvy queries and process logs 24x7 to detect issues. No need to define log based metrics and create alerts manually.
* Relvy then debugs these issues to provide an actionable root cause analysis. This includes querying and analyzing other metrics to provide context, and finding responsible code changes from your recent commits.
* Already have alerts on your on-call slack channel? Relvy can debug these as well, and respond to follow-up queries.

### 🚀 Our tech

* We ship with a small language model that’s optimized for debugging. It is as good as gpt-4o on our eval benchmarks while being 1/100th the cost. The core unlock that enables us to offer continuous monitoring.
* We lean on your previous incident response history to help optimize our agent. Helps us denoise alerts, figure out useful queries to run while debugging, and pattern match logs faster.

### 📝 Our story

Simranjit and I are both ML engineers. We met a few years ago when we were building computer vision models for satellite imagery at a startup called Orbital Insight. Together, we have built and supported ML products at Google, Uber, Microsoft and Amazon. 

Relvy came out of our efforts to automate the not-so-fun parts of our jobs as software engineers. Believe it or not, our first product was something that recorded your screen as you were coding, and tried to come up with bug fix suggestions for any error messages that popped up on screen. Thankfully, Relvy is less intrusive, more accurate, and fits into your existing on-call workflows.

### ➡️ Ask

I bet you’d like AI to take monitoring off your plate. Try us out at <https://www.relvy.ai> or book time with us at <https://calendly.com/bbhat-relvy/15min>

launches.tagline: Vetnio records patient consultations, automating note-taking and other administrative work, so veterinarians can focus more on patient care.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:**

* ⏰ Veterinarians spend \~40% of their time on admin work, with note-taking alone making up \~20% of their time.
* 🎤 By recording patient meetings, Vetnio automatically generates clinical notes and emails in seconds.
* ✨ Additionally, Vetnio helps out with diagnostics, follow-ups, invoice generation, and more, reducing the risk of missed revenue for clinics while ensuring optimal care for animals.

[Introducing Vetnio](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z6KIg5SJUUk)

# **Who are we and why are we doing this?**

We are [Arman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/armankaregar/) and [Max](https://www.linkedin.com/in/max-henry-xie/) from [Vetnio](https://vetnio.com). Being close friends for +10 years, Vetnio is the second startup we have co-founded together. We both have exceptional backgrounds within engineering, with Arman having 20 years of audio processing experience and Max being a self-taught developer since childhood.

It all started when Arman brought his 🐶, Knut  (picture below), to a stressful veterinary visit. He noticed how much time was spent by the veterinarian typing on a keyboard and immediately went on to think how this can be made better. After a quick discussion with Max, the idea for Vetnio was born.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcJzgeyF-gX-baUP0NVgep-EMa_iTLVKHwA9rQoA-Z6QiaTH4EpLeBazL_R_eKkrjHpWEyoNOZB-jKapY7RZ8S4hJesNc3OloZI59SRuyT8aI3ffpGw4lX3YGGRBEbn5k9hIoqThw?key=3XWI3B5KbKFPqOSqe7jrNCyD)

**Problem**\
With a rising patient load, veterinarians are overworked and stressed, leading to mistakes, burnout, and lost revenue. Admin work takes up \~40% of their time, and that's where Vetnio comes in.

**Solution**\
Vetnio has built an AI Copilot that records meetings and writes clinical notes, thereby saving veterinarians and clinics time, money, and headaches. Additionally, Vetnio helps out with diagnostics, follow-ups, invoice generation, and more, reducing the risk of missed revenue for clinics while ensuring optimal care for animals.

[Demo video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5PeoKr2yXSw)

**Case studies and traction**\

launches.body:
https://youtu.be/ffplqbuzfT4

Hey Everyone! We’re Praxim.

**The Problem:**

Microsoft Word serves over a billion users, but Copilot is still stuck in the Stone Age, requiring manual selection just to generate crude, format-ignoring block replacement edits completely devoid of context from your preferences, files, or the web.

**The Solution:**

With a single prompt, Praxim makes edits across your entire document:

* No required manual selection to edit
* No more copy-pasting and context switching between different apps
* No formatting worries
* Takes into account your preferences

Praxim knows exactly what to change and what to keep and edits with word-level granularity—precisely editing only what needs editing, not making brute block replacements.

Most importantly, Praxim creates real Word formatting:

* Actual lists, tables, and styles—not fake imitation structures that are actually just paragraphs
* Maintain formatting, or even change it

Pull data, research, and edit all without leaving Word, with features that 10x your productivity:

* File and Web context
* Voice dictation at the speed of thought
* Intuitive edit previews and clickable references that jump to the location in the document

Praxim is already used for use cases from form filling with data from multiple sources to contract redlining with precise legal edits.

**Why only now?** Programmers left the era crude AI assistance years ago with agentic code editors. Formatted document editing is a far harder technical problem—a single word is encoded by formatting and structural markup several orders of magnitude more complex than plaintext code, with countless ways to render correct text incorrectly. Semantic meaning and formatting both matter.

Praxim for Word solves this, delivering a quantum leap over any other Word editing tool today. Start using Praxim today at [praxim.ai](http://praxim.ai)!

Education is one of the largest and most influential industries in the world, with +20% of the global population being students.

Yet, today’s education system still follows the assembly-line approach from the industrial revolution—leaving students stuck with standardized, one-size-fits-all learning methods that create three major pains:

1. Compromised learning
2. Emotional stress
3. Wasted time

These intensify towards the exam, leaving a glaring problem to be solved. 

![Education: One size no longer has to fit all - Technology and Operations  Management](https://d3.harvard.edu/platform-rctom/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2016/11/animals.jpg)

Until now, solutions like private tutors have been expensive, inaccessible to most, and inconsistent in quality. But with advancements in AI, this is finally changing…

At Alice, we’re a team of former teachers and AI experts using the latest technology to make personalized learning more accessible. 

Alice turns generic course materials into personalized learning and exam prep using AI. Students simply upload what they want to study and instantly get access to:

* **Better understanding** 📚: Key topic overviews with support from an AI chat that knows their context.  
* **Effective practicing** 📝: Tailored exercises (level, format, curriculum, etc.), including flashcards, multiple-choice questions, and full exam simulations and grading. 
* **Targeted improvement** 🎯: Identification of weaknesses for more targeted and complete learning.

Plus, Alice makes learning fun by allowing students to study with or against their friends.

launches.body:
Hello! We’re Frances and Prithvi, founders of Promptless. 

# tl;dr

Docs are integral to a great customer experience, but managing them is a challenging, multi-team effort. The most successful companies recognize that fantastic docs drive adoption and bad ones cause customers to churn. Promptless is already used by fast-growing startups and Fortune 500 enterprises alike to automatically update docs based on feature releases, support tickets, internal Slack conversations, and more. [Get started today](http://gopromptless.ai)! 

<https://www.tella.tv/video/promptless-automatically-update-your-docs-690g>

# The Promptless Approach

**Promptless drafts updates proactively for easy review**

* Our AI agents monitor your software changes for when a documentation update might be needed, and can be triggered from a Slack conversation in one click. No prompt engineering required—hence the name _“Promptless”_.

**Promptless lives where you work and can be triggered anywhere**

* Instead of forcing you into yet another platform, Promptless integrates into your Slack channels, Github repos, Notion databases, Jira/Linear issues, Zendesk/Intercom tickets, and CMS platform.

**Promptless-written docs are designed to maximize value to your customers**

* Promptless is designed to prioritize accuracy, simplicity, and discoverability—ensuring that your customers can be onboarded quickly and can self-support without reaching out to your team.

 **Promptless is built for all kinds of customer docs**

* Whether your docs are product tutorials, help-center articles, or developer guides, Promptless can handle it, and infers the style and structure of your documentation by reading your entire docs site.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87446&key=user_uploads/729272/8196d287-25b1-4175-877b-92f03d41cf74)

# How Customers Use Promptless Today

Promptless is designed to be flexible—it can integrate with any docs platform, be triggered automatically from many workflows, and can pull in context from any internal knowledge source. Just a few examples: 

[Vellum](http://vellum.ai) (YC W23) has tons of Slack Connect channels with their key customers—they use Promptless to automatically trigger doc updates whenever their team answers a customer question that should be covered in their public guides. 

[Clay](https://clay.com/) (breakout prospecting super tool) has a product team that publishes biweekly changelogs and a content team that manages their guides—they use Promptless to automatically bridge that gap and draft new and updated guides whenever there’s a product update.

A Fortune 500 company has full-time technical writers, but the context surrounding every change is spread across Linear, Confluence, and Slack–Promptless automatically assembles the relevant context and drafts doc updates for every PR, making every technical writer twice as productive. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87446&key=user_uploads/729272/0a2388b3-a021-423b-80ba-3dc4d94a23f5)

# Our Team and Expertise

Frances and Prithvi have both run teams where great docs were a critical part of the customer experience. At OneSignal (YC S11) where Frances was Head of Data Science, she saw that docs engagement within the first 24 hours was directly tied to the biggest predictors of customers' lifetime value. At Bond (acquired by NYSE:FIS) where Prithvi was VP of Product and Engineering, he saw the challenging, multi-team effort that it took to maintain great customer docs, and wrote many of the guides himself. 

# Try it out!

If your team wants to spend less time maintaining docs and more time building great product and serving customers, email us at [founders@gopromptless.ai](mailto:founders@gopromptless.ai) or book some time on our calendar [booking link.](http://cal.com/team/promptless/15m-discovery-call)

launches.title: Verbiflow - The Swiss Army Knife For Your Sales Team
launches.tagline: The all-in-one platform for sales teams to capture, manage, and automate their entire process.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're Kashyab and Rishi, co-founders of Verbiflow 😁

# tl;dr

Verbiflow is the all-in-one platform for sales teams to capture, manage, and automate their entire process. Capture leads with intelligent prospecting that identifies high-potential prospects based on real-time events and smart scheduling & routing that instantly assigns those leads to the best-suited sales rep. Manage your pipeline with complete flexibility, defining and tracking custom KPIs across all your sales interactions. Automate reminders and workflows to keep deals moving forward, all within a single, unified platform.

**Ask:** warm intros to sales leaders 😇 (CRO, VP of Sales, & Director of Sales)

<https://youtu.be/0jZayvEkiI4>

# The Problem 👎

Sales teams are grappling with inefficiencies that plague every step of the sales process, from chasing down leads to sealing the deal. For sales reps, the clock is their enemy: they spend just 35% of their time actually selling, leaving about 6.5 hours a day tangled up in manual chores like data entry, prospect hunting, call logging, and scheduling follow-ups. This time sink costs companies roughly $68,000 per rep each year in lost productivity—like paying for a chef who spends most of their shift washing dishes instead of cooking. It’s not just money down the drain; it’s missed chances, too. Leads are 9x more likely to turn into customers if contacted within 5 minutes, but reps buried under admin work can’t keep up, letting golden opportunities slip away.

Account Executives (AEs) are under pressure to close complex deals, but they’re stuck piecing together past interactions from scattered emails, linkedin messages, notes, and tools to get full context on a deal. This chaos makes it nearly impossible to remember key discussions or spot issues threatening the deal like price objections or competitor mentions early enough to act. AEs lack the real-time insights to tackle blockers as such head-on. Meanwhile, they’re bogged down tracking multiple deals across clunky, disconnected systems, while needing to manually update them too. To top it off, deals often land with the wrong AE—like asking a barber to fix your car; they’re skilled with scissors, not engines, and your car’s not going anywhere fast. Win rates tank, and growth goals slip out of reach.

**The outcome?** A frustrated sales team that’s overworked, stretched thin, and underdelivering on the company’s revenue goals.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfsJ9u8AMu5T7GayrI8W-Tj0Tcjadt4A_-xcLxSh-k5kba2Es3uSw9_DWUEHGX4U8X7shcpXwSdLexdlKMBRZl9IYAZLtts1nNR52_7WCMkBvsAT2uVP8vSz3uW34dz6QA6wxTwnw?key=9M7pNCNH6ZN22VTOIZDfTMsS)

# Our Solution 🤩

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87898&key=user_uploads/2368054/5e2c41a3-b5c3-4a66-9342-21d027cba0b0)

**Time Wasted on Manual Tasks** \
Verbiflow automates lead identification, data enrichment, scheduling, and pulls in all your sales interactions. This eliminates the repetitive manual work that eats up 6.5 hours of a rep’s day, letting them focus purely on selling.

**Missed Opportunities and Poor Deal Assignment**\
Verbiflow ensures leads are contacted instantly with automated follow-ups—hitting the 5-minute window when conversions are 9x more likely—while smart routing matches those deals to the best-suited AE based on expertise and performance history. This keeps opportunities alive and optimally assigned without manual effort or guesswork.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87898&key=user_uploads/2368054/e5ba9f9e-6e63-423c-b61a-3414151bf03a)

**Lack of Centralized Context** \
A unified pipeline consolidates all deal-related emails, messages, calls, & notes, into one view. AEs get a full picture instantly, without digging through scattered sources.

**Sales Blockers**\
AI-powered KPIs flag specific hurdles—like pricing objections, competitor mentions, or price consciousness—giving AEs precise insights to resolve issues quickly.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeog_b3ymaSnvHZeJ97Ybp1ql3WqyZwPQBkRwiZyOl5IajGnwuEgU3HTSxbQIH64diOOKnwFsiCQGa5-39n0lKEfs-GEdFzu8tKR-ycfu_tJTVEqnm1J-mxcqIn5Pywph6_ZS-WqQ?key=9M7pNCNH6ZN22VTOIZDfTMsS)

# The Team 🚀

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87898&key=user_uploads/2368054/2fb432c3-988f-4297-b4aa-984792d8837d)

We’ve been spending 10+ hours every day with each other since 2024 & have shared a love for building, movies, & music since we met.

Kashyab has seen sales teams struggle with disorganization and inefficiencies across the board—from billion-dollar giants to seed-stage startups. Rishi has witnessed the fallout: sales teams buckling under high turnover and missed revenue goals, often due to fragmented data and poor handoffs. Together, we bring 7 years of experience building integrations and shaping B2B SaaS products, blending technical expertise with real-world sales insights. Our hands-on understanding of these problems, paired with our ability to ship fast, makes us the perfect team to fix what’s broken in sales.

# Ask 🙌

We’re pouring our all into Verbiflow and could use your help:

* Warm intros to sales leaders (CRO, VP of Sales, & Director of Sales)
* Learn more [here](https://verbiflow.com/) & [book a demo if you’re interested!](https://app.verbiflow.com/calendar)

launches.tagline: We automate EMS quality reviews and billing, reducing errors, maximizing revenue, and improving patient care.
launches.body:
We’re Yos and Timmy – co-founders of [Amby Health](https://tryamby.com) 👋

# **TL;DR**

Ambulance agencies (EMS) waste time and lose revenue due to manual quality reviews and billing, leading to missed errors, under-documented care, and delayed reimbursements. Amby Health automates the entire process, ensuring 100% of patient reports (PCRs) are reviewed in real-time, helping agencies increase revenue, reduce workload, and improve patient care.

Know any **EMS Directors/CEOs or Fire Department Captains**? Please introduce us! 

Email: [contact@amby.health](mailto:contact@amby.health)

# **The Team**

**Yos (CEO):**  MIT dropout, ex-Meta engineer, ML researcher at MIT CSAIL, and former engineer at Allm, a company providing pre-hospital emergency care. He saw firsthand how outdated, manual EMS documentation and billing slow down providers and reduce revenue.

**Timmy (CTO):** – MIT dropout, ex-Amazon/Bloomberg engineer, AI researcher at MIT Media Lab, and healthcare data scientist at OM1. He saw how valuable insights are buried in unstructured medical records, making it hard for providers to act on critical data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87974&key=user_uploads/541108/0d47eceb-120d-4b66-acd1-d3f1a67db38a)

# **The Problem**

EMS quality reviews and billing are still manual and inefficient, leading to:

* **Missed Errors & Compliance Risks** – Incomplete patient reports (PCRs) slip through, leading to under-documented care, protocol violations, and legal exposure.
* **Lost Revenue & Billing Delays** – EMS teams spend hours fixing reports, chasing down medics, and resubmitting claims. Agencies miss out on millions due to denials, coding errors, and charge capture gaps.
* **Slow, Labor-Intensive Process** – Quality review and billing teams are bogged down by manual chart reviews and corrections, delaying reimbursements and patient care improvements.

 

# **Our Solution: AI-Powered EMS Quality Review & Billing**

✅ **Automated Quality Audits** – Identifies errors, missing documentation, and compliance risks instantly.\
✅ **Real-Time Medic Feedback** – Helps providers improve documentation and protocol adherence with instant insights.\
✅ **Billing Optimization** – Ensures complete PCRs, flags missed charges and reduces denials to speed up payments.

The result? EMS agencies recover lost revenue, cut review times, and improve patient care—while reducing manual work. 

One fire department **increased EMS revenue by 33%** (from $350K to $500K) simply by improving its review process.

# **Demo**

<https://youtu.be/eH2ddSKFZOI>

---

**Our Ask**

* Know any EMS Directors/CEOs or Fire Department Captains? Introduce us!
* Reach us at: [contact@amby.health](mailto:contact@amby.health)
* Learn more: [tryamby.com](http://tryamby.com)

launches.title: G LNK - Simplifying collaboration between Pharma & Healthcare professionals
launches.tagline: Meet G LNK, the AI one-stop shop for all medical interactions
launches.body:
Hey YC!

We’re [Raouf](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2360566) and [Rayan](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2366179) — co-founders of G LNK

**TL;DR**

G LNK is an AI-powered platform that connects Pharma companies with doctors & researchers. Rayan worked on this as a consultant, where Pharma companies spent billions annually just to determine how much to pay doctors while staying within regulatory guidelines. Using LLMs, we’re automating the end-to-end process—from identifying candidates to compensation and compliance.\
<https://youtu.be/16oP6roNnZk>

**Problem**

Pharma companies spend over **$70 billion annually** on engaging doctors & researchers, yet a lot of that money is wasted on outdated and manual processes:

* **Outsourcing is expensive and slow**: Companies spend millions on third parties (consulting, recruiting, and regulatory firms)  just to find the right experts and to know how much to pay them compliantly.
* **Compliance risks are high**: Payment miscalculations can lead to regulatory violations and hefty fines
* **Data is scattered**: Contracts, payments and compliance tracking are spread across disconnected systems, making transparency and oversight difficult

<https://youtu.be/qDdFbMWO6eU>

**Solution**

**G LNK automates Pharma companies' entire healthcare professional (HCP) engagement process**—from identifying suitable doctors to engaging them. Here’s how it works:

1. **Identify HCPs:**
   * Identify a doctor from our database of over 3.2 million user profiles (growing 250% MoM).
   * Alternatively, if you know who you want to engage, simply upload the doctor’s CV and we will take care of the rest.
2. **Calculate Compensation:**
   * Instantly determine their compensation rates.
   * Adjust the rates dynamically based on factors such as service type and travel requirements.
3. **Engage Directly:**
   * Contact the selected doctors directly through our platform.
4. **Ensure Compliance:**
   * Maintain regulatory compliance and prevent compliance violations before they happen.
   * Leverage real-time data from trusted sources like NIH, PubMed, CBS, CMS, and more.

This step-by-step solution replaces multiple vendors with a single AI-powered platform, ensuring efficient, compliant, and cost-effective HCP engagement.

**Additional Features**

* **Built-in CRM** to track all HCP engagements
* **Comprehensive financial tracking**, including:
  * All Transfer of Value payments made to HCPs (date, purpose, associated drug)
  * Drug coverage breakdown
  * Monthly payment summaries
  * Payment analysis by Therapeutic Area
* **Tailored recommendations** for grants, conferences, and publications for HCPs
* **Centralized database** of regulations and Codes of Conduct across 150+ countries

**Team**

Rayan and Raouf have known each other for over a decade, with their professional relationship cementing itself during their time as researchers at the University of Chicago.

**Rayan (CEO)** worked as a Life-Sciences Consultant at PwC and was recognized as top consulting analyst in the US for pioneering automation in pharmaceutical compliance. He holds degrees in Chemistry & Economics at UChicago, where he was one of the youngest biochemistry researchers at Pritzker School of Engineering.

**Raouf (CTO)** worked as a ML-researcher at AxLab, where he specialized in developing neural network architectures for multimodal human-computer interaction with adaptive reinforcement learning. He has a multidisciplinary background, with degrees in Computer Science, Astrophysics, & Economics from UChicago

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88235&key=user_uploads/2366179/8a3b2573-1a0d-499b-b252-94260eb9ca1d)

**We are on a mission to help Pharma companies cut costs, enhance accuracy with better benchmarking, and save valuable time. By streamlining these critical processes, we empower Pharma to focus more resources on manufacturing, distribution, and supply—accelerating the delivery of life-changing treatments to those who need them most.**

**Our Asks**

We would really appreciate introductions to anyone working in the Pharma industry or any health-related verticals. Additionally, if you know any physician/research communities, we would love to talk and learn more!

name: Lucidic AI
long_description: Lucidic is trying to find a new paradigm to teach models. The last decade made models intelligent, but intelligence is not the same as experience. Humans do not get better by memorizing thousands of examples; we build learning systems around ourselves: skills, memories, critique, practice, tools, and guidance. And every person learns differently because every task is different. Lucidic brings that idea to AI agents by training a custom learning system for each agent, so it learns what to remember, what skills to build, when to ask for help, and how to improve from experience. The model provides the intelligence, Lucidic gives it a way to learn.
one_liner: Reimagining how Machines Learn

Riviera builds AI Employees for Hotels. Our first agent is a hotel phone receptionist that lets hotels spend less time answering phone calls and more time helping customers. Our system handles front-desk inquiries, in-room dining orders, and reservations. It answers every question instantly and in any language, 24/7.

We are solving a problem that older phone systems and IVRs can't: customers hate not being able to talk to someone immediately, but most travel businesses can’t dedicate additional staff to manage phone lines. Voice AI has always seemed out of reach because the technology infrastructure in the travel industry is often fragmented, with reservation systems, loyalty programs, and in-house operations software that weren’t designed with voice AI in mind. Riviera addresses this by integrating seamlessly with existing software providers and using human-sounding voice models that are highly trained on data specific to each business type and department.

Hotels spend hundreds of billions annually on staffing and risk losing potential revenue when phone lines are overwhelmed or callers hang up. By enabling them to handle unlimited calls, day or night, Riviera unlocks additional revenue and eases labor challenges.

launches.title: Calltree - AI Agent That Optimizes Enterprise Call Center Workflows
launches.tagline: AI operations analyst for enterprise call center workflows
launches.body:
TLDR: Cutting just 1 second off each customer call can save enterprise call centers millions of dollars. Calltree helps enterprises' VP of Operations understand how to make their call center more efficient. Our AI agent analyzes millions of minutes of call center recordings to find inefficiencies in workflows and quantifies the cost of each action. For example, when a rep is handling a credit card dispute, Calltree can identify that reps spend 30 seconds per call on manual data gathering and data entry, propose a solution, and measure the opex savings. Calltree surfaces these insights in an analytics tool and generates reports, making it easy for operation leaders to build business cases to prioritize improvements, realizing millions in opex savings.

Ask: If cutting every second matters to your call center, please email us [kun@calltree.ai](mailto:kun@calltree.ai) and [rob@calltree.ai](mailto:rob@calltree.ai) or [book a demo here.](https://calendly.com/kun-calltree/30min) 

[Checkout our launch video!](https://youtu.be/v-9hFgH_gCI)

**The Problem**

Large enterprises track every second of a phone call because **reducing average call time** can save millions of dollars each year. However, enterprises don't have a scalable way to find these inefficiencies. Manual time studies (in person shadowing call center reps, etc.) are tedious, unscalable, and expensive. 

**What Are Screen Recordings?**

Many contact centers don’t just record the audio of customer calls; they also capture **everything the rep does on their screen** for training, compliance, and quality assurance. **Less than 1% of these screen recordings** are ever reviewed by a manager or analyst and **miss 99% of calls**. This leads to blind spots and missed opportunities for massive cost savings.

**Our Solution**

* **AI agent that finds workflow inefficiencies** (e.g., toggling between multiple systems to complete a single task).
* **Quantify the time and cost** of each action (e.g., “Switching between these five legacy apps costs 20 seconds per call → $5M/year”).
* **Operation leaders use these insights** to build quick business cases to fix inefficiencies. After changes are implemented, Calltree measures the impact pre- and post-fix to **prove cost reductions**.

**Our team**

**Hey everyone! We’re Sukhjit and Sriman, co-founders of Sennu AI (W25).**

## The Problem

Tech consulting firms offer a suite of deeply technical services (SAP S/4HANA migrations, AWS Redshift implementation) with large contract sizes ($100,000-$1,000,000+). Sales representatives at these firms struggle due to a lack of technical knowledge leading to ineffective outbound, inaccurate estimates on pricing, and lost deals. AI has only made this problem worse as SDRs face an increasing number of new unfamiliar services to sell (Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot Studio) and rapid changes in recent years have rendered historical pricing unreliable for many technical services.

## The Solution

**Sennu AI** is our answer to this problem: we provide an **AI SDR** purpose-built for tech consulting companies. Instead of juggling multiple tools and outdated workflows, Sennu AI autonomously:

* **Creates targeted outbound campaigns** based on your specific offerings
* **Sources leads** from across the web, qualifying them through extensive research
* **Crafts personalized emails** with a deep understanding of each prospect’s business needs
* **Syncs seamlessly** with your existing CRM or workflow

All with just one click. By leveraging context on all your previous projects combined with comprehensive business & technical expertise, we’re ensuring that our AI agent sends the most compelling outbound possible to every lead at scale.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0zTwhxxW3Y>

## Backstory

Growing up in a tech consulting family, I (Sriman) experienced firsthand the challenges of running a project-based business, especially a technical one. The lack of recurring revenue meant that sales was an ongoing challenge to keep the lights on year after year. I saw in the previous technology shift how sales reps were left struggling from the radical shift from on-prem to cloud leading to unsuccessful outbound, mistakes in sales calls, and frustrated teams. We aim to prevent the same thing happening again during this shift to AI by solving sales and host of other problems that impact project based businesses.

## Our Team

Sukhjit and Sriman have worked together for over a decade having been debate partners in high school, starting our own tutoring business out of our college dorm, to even interning together at Brex. With strong technical backgrounds—Sukhjit at Brex and Sriman at Confluent—they’re now channeling their expertise into solving a problem that directly affects their own parents, a mission they’re both deeply passionate about.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87149&key=user_uploads/1939169/60643d7e-51cc-4ed4-a495-afd71b8c2851)

## Our Vision

We believe that in the next 10 years humans will no longer be the central processors of information but rather strategic overseers who provide high-level direction. A future service based business will operate as an ecosystem of AI workers that handle all end to end business operations. Sales is just the beginning - at Sennu AI we plan to lead the transformation of service based businesses into the AI age.

**❌ The Problem: Expensive and error-prone accounting**

* CRE firms pay $$$ for lawyers to manually extract data from their leases
* Then they pay $$$ for accountants to reconcile tenant accounts
* The whole process takes 3+ months & often has costly errors.

We learned about the problem from our parents, who own commercial real estate in San Antonio, TX. After trying existing CRE accounting software, we found that the entire process relied on error-prone manual entry and expensive consulting services.

**✅ Our Solution: Replace manual entry with AI**

* TripleZip extracts data from leases with AI (more accurately than humans)
* TripleZip feeds that data into an accounting engine which reconciles accounts instantly
* Done in <1 day, 10X cheaper than hiring a consultant or service firm

We’ve started by automating the most complex part of CRE accounting: Triple-net (NNN) reconciliation. This process accounts for up to 1/3 of the accounting effort for a large CRE firm and often results in expensive human errors and audits.

By reducing the overhead costs of accounting and avoiding costly audits related to NNN reconciliations, we aim to improve our customer’s margins by as much as 25% percent.

# **Double your AI coding output per dollar spent with WOZCODE**

[WOZCODE](https://www.wozcode.com/) is a plugin that augments Claude Code, making it faster, cheaper and higher performing. It installs in two commands, uses your existing Claude subscription, and fits directly into your current tools and workflows (CLI, Claude Desktop App, VS Code, Conductor, etc.)

<https://youtu.be/ISDH4qsLbrM?si=Pm1g7xXYohUX_UVH>

**Problem:**

Last month, our Claude Code spend crossed $100k.

The scary part wasn’t the total. It was how much Claude wasted by being inefficient. Tool call after tool call that bloated context and burned unnecessary tokens. Claude Code is incredible, but too often it was wasting our tokens and money. As a startup we couldn’t continue burning funds in this fashion. 

So we built a fix.

**Solution:**

[WOZCODE](https://www.wozcode.com/) is a plugin that optimizes how Claude Code works under the hood.

Compared to Claude Code alone, WOZCODE delivers:

* **25–55% cost savings**
* **30–40% faster coding tasks**
* **Higher benchmark performance (Terminal Bench: 70% vs 58%)**

For teams using Claude Code heavily, this can mean:

* 50% Lower API spend
* 2x more AI coding throughput
* 2x more output before hitting limits 

\*checkout[ wozcode.com](http://wozcode.com) for side-by-sides on real world coding tasks

**How it works**

Instead of relying solely on the default tools inside Claude Code, WOZCODE uses a set of custom tools designed for efficiency and context optimization.

For example, in vanilla Claude Code, a simple "find and edit 3 files" takes 9+ calls (3× Glob/Grep + 3× Read + 3× Edit) — and call #9 reprocesses all prior output as input tokens.\
\
WOZCODE collapses that to 2 calls (1× Search + 1× batch Edit). The context stays small, so every subsequent call in the session is cheaper. Over a 30-prompt session, this compounding effect drives significant cost savings.

**See what you could be saving:**

Run the below common in your terminal. It scans your existing Claude Code history and shows you exactly what you could have saved over the last 30 days

WOZCODE installs in two commands, uses your existing Claude subscription, and fits directly into your current tools and workflows (CLI, Claude Desktop App, VS Code, Conductor, etc.)

Woz is an AI platform that empowers non-technical entrepreneurs to build and scale real software businesses–no technical cofounder or engineering team required. To start, we’re helping entrepreneurs build high quality mobile apps and launch them directly to the app store.

<https://youtu.be/DFZ5NCKrV58?feature=shared>

### **Problem:**

For most people, finding a technical cofounder is a frustrating and often insurmountable challenge. AI tools for generating prototypes and toy apps only exacerbate the struggle, leaving non-technical users stranded with no way to get from prototype to customer-ready product. 

### **Solution:**

With a proprietary system of AI agents, **Woz enables you to go from idea to production-ready product, eliminating the need to find a technical cofounder or hire developers.** Simply explain your business idea as you would to a human developer, and Woz handles the rest - product, payments, security, infrastructure, scalability, and more. Once you're up and running, Woz provides the tools you need to reach customers, grow sales, and scale your business, all in one place. Think of Woz as the command center for your business. 

### **What Woz is NOT:**

Woz is **NOT** another no-code tool for generating prototypes, demos, or “toy apps” (e.g. surveys, to do lists, landing pages, etc). Maybe you’ve tried tools like Bubble, Lovable, or Bolt–these tools are fun and easy to use, but they're not engineered for business building. At Woz, we take the opposite approach–starting from battle-tested backend infrastructure and then customizing it to your business. That way, everything built on Woz is ready for customers on day one.

We met 13 years ago as roommates at MIT and have been building companies pushing the limits of AI/ML ever since. Brad previously cofounded Cairns Health (YC S17, formerly Totemic) where he led an engineering team of 30+ and built an LLM enabled device to cure chronic insomnia. We’re joined by a world class team of ML scientists and production engineers who’ve worked together for the last 10 years, scaling products to millions of users. launches.body:
Hi Everyone! We’re [Joshua](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/969804), [Hlumelo](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1709047), and [Tycho](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2359695) - cofounders of TensorPool!👋

**TLDR;** Our CLI makes ML model training effortless - just describe your job, and we handle GPU orchestration and execution at half the cost of major cloud providers.

[Get setup in 3 minutes](https://github.com/tensorpool/tensorpool)

Here’s a quick demo of how easy it is to train ML models with TensorPool!

[**TensorPool Demo -- Fine-Tuning DeepSeek**](https://youtu.be/RqqLIVzP780)

# **Problem**

Since high school, when we trained our first ML models, **accessing remote compute has always been a massive hurdle**. As the years went by and we moved further into academia/industry, a good solution never came. Whether it was AWS EC2’s absurd amount of configuration, or Google Colab’s inability to run jobs without your computer being on, nothing left us satisfied. We talked to our co-workers and friends and they all felt the same. We wanted using GPUs to be as easy as programming locally.

# **Solution**

We got together and built a way to **access industry-scale compute from your IDE**. No more SSHing. No more massive data migrations. No more ML Ops headache. Just a simple CLI. \[We also **cut your costs by 50%** which will be explained below :)\]

# **How It Works**

TensorPool has 2 main advantages:

1. **Ease of Use:** 
   * **Don’t leave your IDE:** TensorPool deploys your code directly to GPUs and ships the results back, just as if you were developing locally. 
   * **Intuitive CLI & Configuration:** With TensorPool you can run your job with a single command, kick off several experiments with different tp.config.toml configurations, and version control training jobs with your code.
2. **Price Advantage**
   * **Multi-cloud integration:** We’ve developed technology to do a real time analysis of all available GPU cloud providers, and put your job on the cheapest one.
   * **Spot node resummation tech:** We’ve created a way to give users the price advantage of spot nodes with the reliability of on-demand instances. This leads to \~50% savings!

# **Our ask**

We’re currently giving away $5/week of **free compute** to early users, and would love for you all to **try us out**! Whether your start-up needs an ML infra upgrade or you love messing around with models in your free time – reach out to us we’d love to chat ([team@tensorpool.dev](mailto:team@tensorpool.dev))! You can find all the information to get started [on our GitHub](http://github.com/tensorpool/tensorpool) (**drop us a star while you’re there** 😊) or [our website](https://tensorpool.dev).

**We would also love intros to enterprises** that you believe could benefit from cheaper / easier access to GPUs.

# **Try TensorPool today!**

Below is a quick start:

After completing [the prerequisites](https://github.com/tensorpool/tensorpool?tab=readme-ov-file#prerequisites), we create a “tp.config.toml” ([explained here](https://github.com/tensorpool/tensorpool?tab=readme-ov-file#configuration)), either manually with: 

```
tp config new
```

Or auto-generate one with natural language: 

```
tp config <describe your task>
```

To then deploy and run your job – simply run:

```
tp run
```

and that’s it! Your model is training on cloud GPUs! 

# **About Us**

Joshua, Tycho, and Hlumelo all met their freshman year at Stanford where they got placed on the same dorm floor. Since then, they’ve taken all their classes together and have worked at companies like Apple, Blackstone, DeepMind, Nextdoor, CZI, and PIMCO.

launches.body:
**We're Yash and Ishan, co-founders of Ergo.**

**Ergo is the revenue infrastructure for teams growing faster than their systems can keep up.** We connect the conversations your team is already having, across calls, email, Slack, and more, and build a unified data layer that moves deals forward.

Teams like [Rho](https://rho.co), [RetellAI](https://retellai.com), [Whop](https://whop.com), [Agency Cybersecurity](https://getagency.com), [Corgi](https://corgi.insure), and [Greptile](https://greptile.com) are already running on Ergo.

**📉 The Problem**

Revenue teams are drowning in fragmented data. Your reps are on six different communication channels. None of it connects. None of it acts on itself.

* Deals slip because no one followed up at the right moment
* Leadership asks reps what's happening instead of just knowing
* Marketing sequences run on empty fields because the right data never made it in
* AEs walk into calls without context because handoffs live in someone's Slack DMs

The conversations are happening. The signal is there. It just never goes anywhere.

**📈 The Solution**

Ergo plugs into every channel where your team talks to prospects and customers and builds a unified data layer across all of it. Every call, email, and message gets structured into a single source of truth your entire revenue org can act on.

* **For revenue teams:** Structured deal data captured automatically across every call, email, and message, without touching your CRM
* **For reps:** Follow-ups drafted and surfaced at the right moment, every time
* **For managers and founders:** Real-time pipeline visibility without chasing anyone for updates
* **For RevOps and marketing:** Clean, structured data that actually powers your sequences and reporting

**⚙️ How It Works**

1. **Connect your channels** — Zoom, Google Meet, Gmail, Outlook, Slack, dialers. Wherever your team talks to customers, Ergo listens.
2. **Structure the signal** — Every conversation becomes structured, actionable data across your pipeline.
3. **Execute on what's next** — Follow-ups drafted. Deals surfaced. Pipeline moving. No manual work required.

**🎬 Our Story**

We started at Georgia Tech, and got our first real signal at a YC-backed startup in SF. We spent four days embedded with their sales team and watched 15-20 daily calls evaporate into missed follow-ups and stale records. We built a first version over a weekend that unlocked $75K in closed contracts. That problem turned out to be everywhere.

Today Ergo supports revenue teams running their entire bottom-of-funnel motion, from first conversation to close to expansion, without the admin.

**👉 [joinergo.com](http://joinergo.com)** Questions? [yash@joinergo.com](mailto:yash@joinergo.com) or [ishan@joinergo.com](mailto:ishan@joinergo.com)

launches.body:
Hi! We’re [**Mehul Shah**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mehulmshah22), [**Nick Warren**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nickcw/), [**Matthew Noseworthy**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthew-noseworthy-218167106/) — co-founders of [**GroundControl**](https://rungroundcontrol.com/).

[**https://youtu.be/s2heFLI1R80**](https://youtu.be/s2heFLI1R80)

**TL;DR** — We've onboarded 70+ manufacturing facilities as customers throughout the US. Our core product automates lengthy, complex, and regulated quality documentation in aerospace manufacturing.

**How We Started**

Nick and Matt co-founded their last startup (InspectAR) with Mehul's brother before being acquired by Cadence ($CDNS). I (Mehul) spent the last decade in my family business, where we built PCBs for every advanced system on Earth: rockets, satellites, aircraft, fighter jets, and more. We noticed despite building for innovation, manufacturing operations were antiquated and bogged down with manual processes.

First Article Inspection Reports (AS9102s) were creating a bottleneck in quality. Parts would be built and ready to ship, just waiting on paperwork. Our facilities were doing 15 reports a day, 8 hours per report. The worst part? Even if the part was built exactly to spec — if a single typo was found by the customer, the report would get rejected and payment delayed until the report was fixed.

**What We Built**

Our core product automates first article inspection reporting for regulated manufacturing. Quality teams can balloon drawings and automate inspection report generation in minutes, instead of days.

**Our Vision**

Today, over 70 facilities across the US generate almost 1000 reports a month on our platform. This is just the beginning. We'll continue to build for quality, and upstream towards operations, engineering, and sales to empower manufacturers with AI. GroundControl will embed itself across the global supply chain, from Tier 4 suppliers to OEMs with vertically integrated manufacturing.

**Our Ask**

If you know anyone in regulated manufacturing (aerospace, automotive, medical), or their customers (OEMs like Lockheed, SpaceX, Anduril, etc.) we would love to chat. Reach us at [**founders@gndctl.com**](mailto:founders@gndctl.com) or **408-390-4460**.

name: Clidey
long_description:
WhoDB is an open-source platform for modeling organizations and running decisions on top of their data.

It lets teams define their core entities (customers, accounts, assets, workflows), the relationships between them, and the rules and objectives that govern how decisions should be made. WhoDB continuously ingests operational data and keeps this model up to date in real time.

Instead of building dashboards, writing ad-hoc queries, or maintaining scattered business logic, teams express decisions declaratively—what should happen, under what conditions, and with what constraints. WhoDB evaluates those decisions automatically as data changes and produces actions, recommendations, or state updates.

Everything is transparent and inspectable: data models, decision logic, and outcomes are fully auditable and can be extended in code.
one_liner: Turn scattered data into one platform for decision-making

launches.tagline: Write code, not documentation. Docucod auto-creates and updates docs from your codebase and PRs—so your team stays focused on shipping.
launches.body:
Hello world 🏄 we are [Hemang](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hemangkandwal/) and [Anguel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ahristozov/) from [Clidey](https://www.linkedin.com/company/clidey/), and we are building [Docucod](https://docucod.com/)!

**TL;DR:**

**Docucod automatically generates and maintains complete, always-up-to-date documentation—straight from your codebase.**

Demo video: https://youtu.be/SAaZq9UHAic

# **❗** What is the problem?

On average, developers spend **20–30% of their time** maintaining documentation—and that doesn’t even include the time it takes to create it in the first place. That’s nearly **12 hours in a standard 40-hour week**, often more if you're part of a fast-growing team.

Most tools are still manual and time-consuming, stealing hours better spent building, selling, or scaling.

Great documentation isn’t just helpful—it’s a **growth engine**. Look at Stripe: their docs earn trust and convert users.

The truth? At most companies, documentation is an afterthought (we haven’t written ours yet either!) And we get it—“documentation specialist” usually isn’t on anyone’s job title.

# 💡 What is the solution?

**Docucod auto-generates and maintains always-up-to-date documentation—straight from your codebase.** You continue building, we’ll focus on the documentation.

It fits effortlessly into your workflow, whether you’re a small team or managing complex repos.

From onboarding guides to API references and system diagrams, Docucod delivers clear, comprehensive docs with zero manual work.

Fully editable and always in sync, it lets you ship fast **and** document well—without compromise.

# 🧠 How it works:

* Connect your GitHub account and select a repo.
* Docucod scans your repo to understand its structure and functionality, building an intelligent knowledge graph that maps out components, features, code flow, and so on.
* It creates a structured documentation plan, outlining sections, navigation, and individual pages.
* Docucod generates rich content with diagrams and contextual clarity.
* Finally, it automatically pushes the documentation back to your repo for deployment.

# 😎 Want to see some real examples?

https://github.com/clidey/whodb-docs - deployed at http://whodb-docs.docucod.com/

https://github.com/clidey/todos-docs - deployed at https://todo-docs.docucod.com/

# 💯 Who Are We and Why Did We Build This?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90620&key=user_uploads/1558575/1eddcff2-4b1a-4343-847d-eb35680c9693)

We’re Hemang and Anguel—friends, builders, and longtime hackathon teammates. After years working at places like Palantir, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley, we saw one issue everywhere: documentation gets rushed, postponed, or skipped—and the fallout is always the same.

We built Docucod because this isn’t a people problem—it’s a systems problem. The fix isn’t better habits. It’s automation.

> **We’re here to make documentation sexy again.**

# 🤔 Is Docucod right for you?

**Don’t use Docucod if:**

🚫 You enjoy rewriting GitHub auth instructions.

🚫 You love writing and maintaining docs by hand.

**Use Docucod if:**

✅ You want docs that stay up to date—automatically.

✅ You want new hires productive on Day 1.

✅ You’d rather ship than document.

# 🥹 Our ask:

If this resonates with you, **get in touch:**

[hemang.kandwal@clidey.com](mailto:hemang.kandwal@clidey.com), [anguel.hristozov@clidey.com](mailto:anguel.hristozov@clidey.com), or

https://calendly.com/clidey/conversation-with-clidey-15-min - if there’s a time that you’d like to speak but it shows as unavailable, please just message us!

If you owned documentation or know someone who owns it now, we would love to get a warm introduction.

Let’s make documentation an asset—not a chore.

That’s our fish! 👇

Hi everyone! We’re [Amine](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amine-amor-4a7a42135/), [David ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidstromback/)and [Mark](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mark-feldner/), and we’re building Crimson - the AI associate for litigation lawyers.

Litigators deal with thousands of case files, often spanning several years. Crimson processes all that data and uses its understanding of each case to analyze legal arguments, locate evidence and draft documents.

**Crimson saves litigation lawyers 10+ hours of manual work each week.**

[Crimson Launch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kSzn7CMqX5s)

* Case files are scattered across Outlook, shared drives and document management systems.
* Lawyers spend hours reviewing letters, emails, transcripts and evidence, identifying key issues, and drafting case-specific documents.
* Existing AI tools aren’t built for litigation workflows.

**The solution:** Crimson’s AI associate that knows each dispute inside-out

* Crimson automatically organizes and analyzes case documents, extracts key legal issues, and identifies inconsistencies between party positions.
* Lawyers can ask questions such as “What have the defendants said about termination?” and get answers with citations across pleadings, hearing transcripts, letters and other case files.
* Crimson helps legal teams draft arguments, chronologies and letters with content tailored to each case.

**Why are we building this?**

* Mark spent seven years as a litigator at leading law firms. He lost countless hours trawling through case files, searching for evidence and manually drafting documents.
* With recent advances in reasoning models, we can now build an AI associate that understands the nuances of complex legal arguments.
* Horizontal AI tools will only go so far. To unlock real value, lawyers need a context-aware platform that is tailored for litigation workflows. Crimson is that tool.

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** AI-powered truck management software to automate back-office operations for trucking companies.\
[**Check us Out!**](https://drive.google.com/file/d/18BF2PM5YkSSTOXs9yqM_CQ0jv2Gy9xFD/view?usp=sharing)

**The Problem and Solution:**

Trucking has always been a mission critical industry, with nearly 70% of all US goods hauled via trucks, resulting in a need for continuous operations. This results in an industry that hasn’t paused for a tech update in years; in my time in the industry, I saw dozens of offices running on pen and paper or excel spreadsheets, documents being sent in WhatsApp group chats connected to printers, and I myself had 3 phones all on hold menus with different people. And even the largest of companies today navigate a maze of outdated, poorly integrated point-solutions.

So, alongside Anthony and Sam, I decided to build a product that rectifies those problems. With Hemut’s software, you can replace pen and paper scribbles with intuitive oversight of even national level fleets, replace the WhatsApp group chats and manual data entry with AI document parsing, and eliminate the need for 3 phones with AI agents to automate inbound/outbound calls. With Hemut, trucking companies can execute every step of the trucking workflow—from finding and booking a shipment, driver communication, and logging every last dollar—all on one platform, with efficiency never seen before.

**The Story:**

At 16 years old, I got kicked out of my home and faced homelessness, working 100-hour weeks at a motel where I met a truck driver who I eventually helped file paperwork for. Siezing the opportunity, I also helped file paperwork for his friends too, eventually saving enough money to start dispatching trucks and put a roof over my head.

Fast forward 6 years to the end of 2024, I realized that voice AI would eventually be capable enough to automate a lot of the bottlenecks I encountered during my time in the logistics industry.

**Our Ask:**

Always looking to learn about the cutting edge of tech and the people driving the innovation so feel free to say hi. If you also happen to know anyone in the trucking industry (veteran trucker. investor, or dev), we’d love to be introduced!

Hey YC, we’re [João](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joaopdepaula/), [Lucas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lucasbrunosilva/), and [Sergio](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sergio-bergmann/), cofounders of [**Mesmer**](http://mesmer.co/) — **Cursor for CTOs.**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TMO7TQUZIuU

We’re **repeat founders and CTOs behind startups like Glio (S13) and [Origin Financial](http://useorigin.com/) ($400M)**. In every team we built, we ran into the same challenge: each new customer, employee, and feature made it harder to understand what was actually going on. We spent our days in back-to-back meetings and chasing status updates, and forced our teams to do busywork just to keep us in the loop. **Yet we still didn’t see problems until something broke**.

AI is already making the 10x engineer possible. But there’s no solution that helps **product development orgs — and product leaders — 10x themselves**. That’s what we’re building.

# **Enter Mesmer**

**Mesmer gives founders and CTOs full context on their org without drowning in meetings or chasing people for updates**. It watches the work itself — code, specs, designs, meetings — to build a live, detailed picture of what’s going on. Our customers can keep their teams fast, flat, and focused as they scale — and free from busywork.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90395&key=user_uploads/178/c0f0220d-62be-4e38-9246-ecd3c2493a79)

We are starting with **an AI chief of staff for product development orgs**. Every week, it delivers a report showing what actually happened across all in-flight projects: what moved forward, what shipped, and what’s stuck. Founders and CTOs can then ask questions and get in-depth answers based on their team’s actual code, specs, and designs, like:

* Why is this project slipping?
* Who’s the best engineer to unblock it?
* What architecture did we use in this repo?
* How does the business logic work for this categorization engine?
* What changed in the roadmap last week?

**We’re already live with 10+ companies worth over $3B** and have reviewed over 70M lines of code along the way. We’d love to help you, too.

# **Special Offer**

We’re onboarding companies as fast as we can, but, if you’re a CTO leading a team of 20+ engineers (or know someone who is) **email me at [joao@mesmer.co](mailto:joao@mesmer.co) and we’ll skip the line** to help you run a flat, fast, focused org right away.

\

launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We're [Eddie](https://www.linkedin.com/in/eddieconk/), [Logan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/logan-carmody/), and [Max](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mmpollard/) – co-founders of [Cotool](https://cotool.ai).

### TL;DR

Cotool uses AI to automate repetitive security workflows so teams can focus on threat hunting instead of manual tasks. Our early users have used the copilot and agents to cut investigation time by 90% and increase detection quality & coverage. Book a demo to learn how you can do the same!\
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GnyZuJGQ5C0

### ❌ The Problem

Security is complex, but the problems facing most teams are not:

1. Alert Fatigue: Hours lost to false positives, while genuine threats slip by unnoticed.
2. Context Switching: Investigations requiring constant toggling across 5-10 disconnected tools just to assemble basic context.
3. Documentation Overhead: Teams spend more time as technical writers than security practitioners, bogged down in endless reporting.

Before founding Cotool, we collaborated with cutting-edge security teams including OpenAI, Coinbase, Figma, and DoorDash, experiencing these universal challenges firsthand.

Advancements in AI now offer an opportunity to truly reimagine this model; by building intuitive, collaborative tools that complement, not replace, security professionals.

### 👷 Our Solution

Cotool provides a suite of Agents and an AI co-pilot designed specifically for security teams, streamlining workflows and reducing frustration through:

* Seamless Investigations 🔍: A true AI co-pilot that works alongside security engineers during alert triage, investigations, and detection engineering; automatically gathering relevant context from across tools so they can focus on reasoning, not tool-hopping.
* No-code Agents 🤖: Turn successful debugging flows into reusable agents, then refine their behavior with natural language prompts and connect them to any tools Cotool has access to, with granular permission controls.
* Automated Documentation 📊: Generating thorough, accurate reports in seconds, freeing up valuable security practitioner time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90398&key=user_uploads/2254937/d59dd9d1-e396-4f77-8dce-283a5e31c4ee)

### 👨‍💻 The Team

We have worked together for years and co-founded Cotool in 2025.

[Max Pollard](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mmpollard/) (CEO) led the forward deployed engineering team at Material, working directly with security teams to understand their workflows and pain points. He built the team up from one to 8 engineers and embedded himself with the world's best security programs. Previously he worked as a SE at Okta. He holds a BA in Business and Computer Science from UC Berkeley.

[Eddie Conk](https://www.linkedin.com/in/eddieconk/) (CPO + Head of AI) spent the last 3 years at Material Security, leading the ML Engineering function. He developed and trained AI models for detecting Phishing emails at scale for some of the largest and most secure companies in the world. Previously he was an ML Engineer at Apple, and holds a BA in Computer Science from UC Berkeley.

[Logan Carmody](https://www.linkedin.com/in/logan-carmody/) (CTO) was an early engineer and the technical lead for the Phishing Protection product at Material Security. He helped develop the proprietary language and compiler which Material’s threat researchers used to detect Phishing messages and Workspace breaches. He previously was a Staff SWE at LinkedIn working in infrastructure, and holds a BS in Computer Science and Philosophy from Duke University.

Together, we've spent years embedded with some of the world's best security teams. We're passionate about helping security teams focus on what they do best – hunting threats, not handling workflows.

Cascade Space was founded to build the ground station company of the future. But lack of large dishes is not the only thing broken about space communications, so are the design tools. 

Industry standard spreadsheets are painful to build and maintain and error prone, but they can at least get you started. That said, they completely break down once you need to predict how your spacecraft will perform in real world dynamic environments, analyzing multiple variations of a system, or sharing and keeping the design updated across teams.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96236&key=user_uploads/222992/5bdf36f9-9f71-4796-9f12-ecbeba37d8c4)

Every space company eventually starts to build internal tooling to parse 3D antenna patterns and scripts to evaluate link performance over given flight trajectories. This is usually unplanned work done by RF engineers that takes months to get even a rudimentary implementation up and running. This software is very bespoke and often brittle, and makes the tight timelines of early stage companies even tighter.

Across the industry this work gets duplicated over, and over, and over. 

**Enter Cascade Designer**. The pipeline is already built. Start by designing your system in a graphical interface, get your link margin with a single button click. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96236&key=user_uploads/222992/7e4a5642-dc70-4093-a7d5-5a2b1802cda3)

Next, analyze entire trajectories with a single API call.

Designs can be shared with anyone on your team through our interface

We built this out because the customers of the best ground network need the best design tools, but we didn’t just build this for our ground station customers. Anyone designing a spacecraft for any orbit using any ground station can use it.

launches.title: Cascade Space - Deep space communications as a service
launches.tagline: Your next lunar mission just got easier!
launches.body:
# tl;dr

Cascade Space is building a turn-key communications system for lunar and deep space missions. Our ground station network and integrated software tools work together to maximize uptime and availability, while reducing spacecraft iteration cycles from weeks to hours. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/7b3a56ce-8dc0-48db-a2e5-3badb2afd893)

**Why are we building this and why now?**

The Deep Space Network (DSN), NASA’s global network of ground terminals for communicating with deep space probes, is [oversubscribed by 40% and in desperate need of upgrades.](https://newspaceeconomy.ca/2024/09/02/nasas-deep-space-network-challenges-and-the-road-ahead/) The DSN is all but unavailable for most commercial operations. Companies with missions going to the Moon and beyond have to deal with a patchwork of individual dish operators for every mission, each with bespoke hardware, specs, and interfaces. Furthermore, many of these commercial providers are not able to handle the demand and [operational failures also can lead to loss of mission](https://www.astroforge.com/updates-collection/odint-mission-debrief).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/c6aa8968-e567-42e5-8866-866414630f22)

**Comms system design is fraught with peril**

The spacecraft comms system design is tightly coupled to the available ground network. Engineers spend hundreds of hours poring over datasheets, on the phone with vendors and suppliers, and endless email threads, only to put all this data into a giant spreadsheet to make sense of it. Every iteration requires not only painful attention to detail, but also in-depth esoteric knowledge of how radio frequency systems and channel coding schemes work in order to accurately predict in-flight performance. Simple misunderstandings can lead to catastrophic errors in design and configuration.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/1623d16f-4789-4793-892f-2c7adffc84a7)

**End-to-end comms system validation often doesn’t happen**

Fully integrated testing between the spacecraft and ground terminal is typically cost prohibitive. Instead, engineers compare spec sheets and email configurations to the ground operators, and hope it works in flight (spoiler alert: it often doesn’t). It is routine for spacecraft to fly having never done an end-to-end test of their system with ground terminal representative hardware. The whole process is subject to human error from end to end. 

**This approach to space communications does not scale**

Commercial space ventures beyond low earth orbit have already pushed existing infrastructure to its breaking point, and demand for deep space comms support is expected to grow exponentially over the next decade. We will not have a spacefaring future for humanity until communications for spacecraft become as easy as signing up for cable internet. 

**We are redefining the process, starting with spacecraft design**

Better comms starts at the beginning, in the early trade study and design phase. We are replacing industry-standard spreadsheets with a modern software tool that lets you see how your system will perform with our ground network in real time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/4873c5a0-9288-48fe-8d2e-a3a32f3fcad0)

**Test as you fly, fly as you test**

You don’t rise to the level of your expectations, you fall to the level of your testing. We ship you a “ground station in a box,” identical to hardware we’ve installed at the ground stations you will be using, and provide you with a test plan that you can use to test your entire system end to end, with both the space vehicle and the ground terminal in the loop. 

**Launch with confidence**

Fly and operate your spacecraft. Use our API to schedule passes on our network, track your spacecraft, stream data, monitor the ground site, and access recordings.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/2b01ca98-b6d7-4f8b-9af5-5b93b0613ef0)

**We are rolling out our preliminary network rapidly**

We start by partnering with owners of dishes that are currently unused for any other telemetry applications. This allows us to build out the product and acquire customers with a minimal amount of capital. As we build out the network, we will further expand our network by strategically building our own ground stations in key locations. Our first downlink only ground stations are expected to come online in 2025, with more to follow in 2026.

**We are passionate about your mission success**

[Jacob](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/30556) and [Arlen](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2222230) have solved many of these exact problems at company level scales in previous roles. Jacob was RF system architect at SpaceX and Arlen has built complex hardware/software systems his entire career. Collectively they have spent hundreds of hours in mission control, many of those hours dealing with anomalies and outright failures. They are both passionate about building the culture of excellence at Cascade that is required for flawless mission execution.

**If you are struggling with comms for your upcoming mission, drop us a line. We can help.**

https://cascade.space/

# The Problem

Electrical estimating - the process of figuring out how much an electrical construction project will cost is super tedious and can take anywhere from a few hours to months. Imagine reading through 500-page PDFs, counting hundreds of small symbols per page on 50 pages of complicated circuits, and manually entering thousands of numbers on slow, legacy software.

Electrical estimators do this process everyday but manually, and most of the time, they lose the job by a small margin. Estimating is the only way electrical contractors make revenue, and they do it manually because one mistake can cost thousands of dollars and they need to be careful!

# Our Solution

Because estimating is such a careful process, electrical contractors still do everything manually, especially because AI is hard to trust. That’s why we built Bidflow - an AI copilot for electrical estimating that serves as an assistant not a replacement.

Bidflow is designed with context to think like an electrician and most importantly, show the estimator “proof of work”, turning the estimators job more into reviewing the AI’s mistakes. We’re able to process all of your project documents and save you time in reading through hundreds of pages of fine print.

Bidflow also has the same features as the legacy softwares these estimators use, but it combines everything together, making it an all-in-one platform that also saves estimators time switching between the softwares.

<https://youtu.be/GzvbzYwVzZM>

### Our Team

We decided to target electrical contractors because we both have family in the industry who’ve complained about how slow work has been. We then decided to go door-to-door in the Bay Area and got our first design partner.

Jesse (CEO, right) - **Top 1%** competitive coder in the US; **Jane Street** extern. Gautham (CTO, left) - Bootstrapped to **$120K** at **16**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96918&key=user_uploads/1512811/3c223688-5b55-49b7-b1bf-e08439b4b1e4)

### Why Now?

Construction is picking up in the United States, and the demand for electrical work is going up due to the data center boom. New data centers are being built left and right, meaning there’s a lot of electrical construction projects in the market. A huge boost in estimating efficiency would give the faster electrical contractors a huge advantage in winning jobs, and with AI agents getting better now more than ever, now is the time to bring AI into the electrical estimating workforce.

name: Playgent
long_description:
When enterprise agents fail in production, the conditions that caused the failure are critical: user state, data, tool calls, and context. Without a way to recreate these conditions, teams can't fix what broke.

Playgent provides infrastructure to create high-fidelity sandbox environments for AI agents. Our environments come packaged as a single MCP url where tool calls are mocked, authentication is abstracted away, and test data can be initialized via natural language or JSON specifications.

Teams can use Playgent to reproduce production failures in safe, scoped environments that accurately reconstruct state. Finally, export runs as OTel traces from Playgent's environment to plug directly into your observability tools or RL pipelines.
